catalog.name: Inventory Valuation and Costing calculations
catalog.description: Every formula, algorithm, rounding rule and worked example of the inventory valuation and costing domain, in a structured form a rebuild can test against: the three precisions and the rounding functions, the unit conversion of a valuation quantity, the seven sources of the value priority chain, the completion valuation routine and its outgoing correction, the maintenance of the product unit cost under each costing method, the three batch valuation routines with the average replay and the first in first out stack, negative stock and its correction, the landed cost split with its five split methods and its rounding residue, the production value of finished goods and by-products, the cost of goods sold of an invoice line, the price difference at the vendor bill under standard price, the three parts of the inventory valuation closing, the analytic distribution of a movement, the value of a stock quantity record, the costing method change, valuation at a past date, the cost and margin of a sales order line, and the value shown on the forecast report.
catalog.authored_from: docs/domains/inventory-valuation-and-costing/calculations.md, with the ledger effects of docs/domains/inventory-valuation-and-costing/accounting-effects.md and the rule identifiers of docs/domains/inventory-valuation-and-costing/business-rules.md

records.name: The three precisions that govern valuation figures
records.purpose: Fixes which precision applies to each kind of valuation figure, so that a rebuild rounds money, displayed unit costs and quantities in the same three distinct ways the domain does.

operands.name: monetary amount
operands.source: any valuation figure: the value of a goods movement, the remaining value, the total value, the amount of a journal item, the amount of a landed cost line or of an adjustment line
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: unit cost of a product or of a lot
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit of measure
operands.source: the unit cost field of the product or of the lot
operands.constraints: stored at full floating precision, never truncated on storage

operands.name: currency decimal places
operands.source: the currency record of the company
operands.constraints: two for most currencies

operands.name: Product Price decimal precision
operands.source: the named decimal precision record for product prices
operands.constraints: two by default

operands.name: Product Unit decimal precision and the rounding of the unit of measure
operands.unit_or_currency: a count of decimal places and a rounding step
operands.source: the named decimal precision record for product units, and the rounding step of each unit of measure
operands.constraints: two decimal places and a step of 0.01 by default

preconditions.condition: The currency of the company is known, so that its decimal places are available.
preconditions.otherwise: No monetary figure can be written; the calculation that needed it is not meaningful.

procedure: Round every monetary field to the decimal places of the currency at the moment the field is written; leave intermediate arithmetic unrounded unless a rule says otherwise.

Keep the unit cost of a product and the unit cost of a lot at full floating precision in storage; apply the Product Price decimal precision only when the figure is displayed, and when two prices are compared for the two tolerance tests.

Use the Product Price decimal precision as the comparison tolerance in exactly two places: the test that decides whether a cost-of-goods-sold line is worth creating, and the test that decides whether a price difference is worth posting.
Compare every quantity, whether to zero or to another quantity, at the Product Unit decimal precision or at the rounding step of the unit of measure.
records.formula: displayed_unit_cost = unit_cost rounded to the Product Price decimal precision ; stored_unit_cost = unit_cost at full floating precision ; stored_monetary_field = round_to_currency( amount ) at the moment of writing ; quantity comparisons are made at the rounding step of the unit of measure

rounding.what: Monetary fields; the display of a unit cost; the two price comparison tolerances; every quantity comparison.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the currency for money; the Product Price decimal precision for displayed and compared prices; the Product Unit decimal precision or the unit-of-measure rounding step for quantities.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for money and for prices; comparison at the step for quantities.
rounding.step: Money at the moment the field is written; prices only at display and at the two tolerance tests; quantities at every comparison.

result.name: rounded figure
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency, a price, or a quantity in the reference unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the field that carries the figure; the unit cost is stored unrounded and rounded only for display.

edge_cases.case: Three receipts of one unit each at 1.00 and then a correction of the first to 2.00.
edge_cases.outcome: The unit cost becomes 4 ÷ 3 = 1.333333… and the total value is exactly 4.00, while the sum of the three movements' remaining values is 3.99, because each remaining value is rounded to the currency separately as 1.33.

edge_cases.case: A currency whose smallest representable increment is not one hundredth.
edge_cases.outcome: The decimal places of that currency govern instead; the same half-away-from-zero rule applies on its own step.

edge_cases.case: A quantity smaller than the rounding step of its unit of measure.
edge_cases.outcome: It compares equal to zero, so a movement carrying only such a quantity counts as a zero-quantity movement.

worked_examples.description: The unit cost is not truncated on storage while the remaining values are rounded one by one
worked_examples.narrative: Four units of currency divided by three units of goods is 1.333333…, kept at full precision on the product. The total value stays exactly 4.00. Each of the three remaining values is rounded to the currency on its own as 1.33, and 1.33 + 1.33 + 1.33 = 3.99, one hundredth short of the total value.

records.name: Rounding a monetary amount to the currency
records.purpose: Reduces any monetary result to a value the company currency can represent, which is the rounding applied to every stored amount of the domain.

operands.name: amount
operands.source: any intermediate monetary result of the domain
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: decimal places of the currency
operands.source: the currency record
operands.constraints: at least zero

preconditions.condition: The currency to round to is known.
preconditions.otherwise: The amount cannot be written and the computation that produced it is not meaningful.

procedure: Take the amount as computed, without any earlier rounding of the intermediate arithmetic.
Round it to the number of decimal places of the currency, carrying a tie away from zero.
Write the rounded amount to the field.
records.formula: round_to_currency( amount ) = the amount rounded to the decimal places of the currency, half away from zero

rounding.what: Every monetary field of the domain at the moment it is written.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the currency the amount is expressed in, normally two.
rounding.step: At the end of the computation, immediately before the value is stored or compared.

result.name: rounded amount
result.unit_or_currency: the currency being rounded to
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the monetary field that carries it.

edge_cases.case: The amount sits exactly on a half of the last decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: The half is carried away from zero: 0.005 becomes 0.01 and −0.005 becomes −0.01.

edge_cases.case: The amount is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero and the sign is immaterial.

edge_cases.case: The currency has no decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is a whole number of currency units.

worked_examples.description: A third of one hundred rounded to a currency with two decimal places
worked_examples.narrative: Thirty-three point three three three three… rounded to two decimal places gives 33.33; the discarded remainder is below one half of a hundredth, so nothing is carried.

worked_examples.description: A tie carried away from zero on a negative amount
worked_examples.narrative: Five thousandths is exactly one half of one hundredth, so the tie is carried away from zero and the negative sign is kept, giving minus one hundredth.

records.name: Rounding a value to the nearest multiple of a step
records.purpose: Rounds a quantity or a price to the nearest multiple of a given step, which is how the unit price of a purchase order line and the complement of a by-product cost share are reduced.

operands.name: amount
operands.unit_or_currency: a price, a quantity or a bare number
operands.source: the intermediate result of the computation that calls this rule
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: step
operands.unit_or_currency: the same unit as the amount
operands.source: the caller: one ten-thousandth for the complement of a by-product cost share, ten raised to the negative Product Price decimal precision for the unit price of a purchase order line
operands.constraints: strictly greater than zero

preconditions.condition: The step is strictly greater than zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The amount is left unchanged.

procedure: Divide the amount by the step.
Round the quotient to the nearest whole number, carrying a tie away from zero.
Multiply the whole number obtained by the step.
records.formula: round_half_up( amount , step ) = the amount rounded to the nearest multiple of the step, ties away from zero

rounding.what: The amount handed to the rule.
rounding.precision: The step handed to the rule: one ten-thousandth for a cost-share complement, ten raised to the negative Product Price decimal precision for a purchase unit price.
rounding.step: At the step named by the caller: the last step of the purchase unit price computation, and immediately before the complement of the by-product cost share multiplies the total production cost.

result.name: rounded value
result.unit_or_currency: the same unit as the amount
result.stored_or_displayed: Passed on to the caller; the purchase unit price is written to the movement's unit price field.

edge_cases.case: The amount is already a multiple of the step.
edge_cases.outcome: It is returned unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The amount sits exactly on a half step.
edge_cases.outcome: The half is carried away from zero, so 0.00005 with a step of one ten-thousandth becomes 0.0001.

edge_cases.case: The step is one.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is a whole number.

worked_examples.description: The complement of a by-product cost share of twenty-five percent
worked_examples.narrative: One minus twenty-five divided by one hundred is 0.75, already a multiple of one ten-thousandth, so the rounding leaves it at 0.7500.

worked_examples.description: A purchase unit price rounded at two decimal places
worked_examples.narrative: Ten point zero zero five divided by one hundredth is 1000.5; the tie is carried away from zero to 1001; multiplied by one hundredth this is 10.01.

records.name: Testing whether an amount is zero for a currency
records.purpose: Decides whether a monetary difference is small enough to be treated as nothing, which is the gate on posting a price difference, on posting a closing pair and on accepting the landed cost sum check.

operands.name: amount
operands.source: any monetary difference of the domain
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: decimal places of the currency
operands.source: the currency record
operands.constraints: at least zero

preconditions.condition: The currency to test against is known.
preconditions.otherwise: The test cannot be made; the caller treats the amount as not zero and proceeds.

procedure: Round the amount to the currency.
Report true when the rounded amount equals zero and false otherwise.
records.formula: is_zero_for_currency( amount ) = true when round_to_currency( amount ) = 0

rounding.what: The amount under test, for the purpose of the test only; the amount itself is not modified.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the currency, normally two.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, inherited from the currency rounding.
rounding.step: At the moment of the comparison.

result.name: truth value
result.unit_or_currency: not applicable
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the caller as a gate.

edge_cases.case: The amount is smaller than half of the last decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: It rounds to zero and the test reports true, so the caller skips the posting.

edge_cases.case: The amount is exactly half of the last decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: It rounds away from zero to one unit of the last decimal place and the test reports false.

edge_cases.case: The currency has no decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: Any amount below one half of a currency unit is treated as zero.

worked_examples.description: A residue of four thousandths against a currency with two decimal places
worked_examples.narrative: Four thousandths rounds to 0.00 at two decimal places, so the test reports true and no correcting item is produced.

worked_examples.description: A residue of one hundredth
worked_examples.narrative: One hundredth is already representable, so the test reports false and the residue is carried onto an adjustment line.

records.name: Comparing two quantities at the precision of the unit of measure
records.purpose: Decides the order of two quantities, or whether a quantity is zero, at the precision the unit of measure allows, which gates the first in first out stack, the zero-quantity test and the landed cost line selection.

operands.name: first quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: second quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the caller, often zero
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: rounding step of the unit of measure
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the unit of measure record, or the Product Unit decimal precision
operands.constraints: strictly greater than zero, 0.01 by default

preconditions.condition: Both quantities are expressed in the same unit of measure.
preconditions.otherwise: The comparison is meaningless; the quantities must first be converted into the product reference unit of measure.

procedure: Round both quantities to the rounding step of the unit of measure.
Report minus one when the first rounded quantity is smaller than the second, zero when they are equal, and plus one when the first is greater.
records.formula: compare_quantities( a , b ) = −1 , 0 or +1 , comparing a and b after rounding both to the rounding step of the unit of measure

rounding.what: Both quantities, for the purpose of the comparison only.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the unit of measure, 0.01 by default.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied on the step before comparing.
rounding.step: At the moment of the comparison; the stored quantities keep their own values.

result.name: comparison outcome
result.unit_or_currency: not applicable
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the caller as a branch.

edge_cases.case: Both quantities round to the same multiple of the step.
edge_cases.outcome: They compare equal, so a stack size of 0.004 is treated as not greater than zero and the stack is returned empty.

edge_cases.case: A quantity is exactly half a step.
edge_cases.outcome: It rounds away from zero to one step and compares greater than zero.

edge_cases.case: The unit of measure has a coarser step, for example one whole unit.
edge_cases.outcome: Fractions below one half of a unit compare equal to zero.

worked_examples.description: A residual stack size below the step
worked_examples.narrative: Four thousandths rounds to 0.00 at a step of one hundredth, so it compares equal to zero and the first in first out stack is returned empty with a bottom quantity of zero.

worked_examples.description: A quantity of eleven grams expressed in kilograms
worked_examples.narrative: Eleven thousandths of a kilogram rounds to 0.01 at a step of one hundredth, which is greater than zero, so the quantity counts.

records.name: Converting a movement quantity into the product reference unit of measure
records.purpose: Brings every valuation quantity onto one scale, the product reference unit of measure, so that costs per unit and quantities on hand can be multiplied together whatever unit the movement was recorded in.

operands.name: movement quantity
operands.source: the quantity recorded on the goods movement or on one of its lines
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: movement unit factor
operands.unit_or_currency: a ratio to the reference unit of measure
operands.source: the unit of measure of the movement
operands.constraints: strictly greater than zero

operands.name: reference unit factor
operands.unit_or_currency: a ratio to the reference unit of measure
operands.source: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.constraints: strictly greater than zero, one for the reference unit itself

preconditions.condition: The movement unit of measure and the product reference unit of measure belong to the same category of units.
preconditions.otherwise: No conversion is possible and the quantity cannot be valued.

preconditions.condition: The reference unit factor is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The division cannot be performed and the conversion is not meaningful.

procedure: Multiply the movement quantity by the factor of the movement unit of measure.
Divide the product by the factor of the product reference unit of measure.
Round the result to the precision of the product unit, keeping the movement's own quantity unchanged in its own unit.
records.formula: reference_quantity = movement_quantity × movement_unit_factor ÷ reference_unit_factor

rounding.precision: The Product Unit decimal precision, or the rounding step of the reference unit of measure.
rounding.step: After the multiplication and the division, when the converted quantity is compared or stored; the movement keeps its own quantity in its own unit unrounded by this rule.

result.name: reference quantity
result.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Used as the valuation quantity; the movement's own quantity field keeps the quantity in the movement unit of measure.

edge_cases.case: The movement is already expressed in the reference unit.
edge_cases.outcome: Both factors are equal, so the quantity passes through unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The converted quantity falls below the rounding step of the reference unit.
edge_cases.outcome: It rounds to a multiple of that step, so eleven grams of a product measured in kilograms becomes 0.01 kilogram.

edge_cases.case: The movement quantity is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion keeps the sign; the reference quantity is negative.

worked_examples.description: Eleven grams of a product whose reference unit is the kilogram
worked_examples.narrative: Eleven multiplied by the gram factor of 0.001 is 0.011, which rounds to 0.01 kilogram at the product-unit precision. The movement still records eleven grams; only the valuation quantity is 0.01 kilogram.

worked_examples.description: One dozen of a product whose reference unit is the unit, at a unit cost of ten
worked_examples.narrative: One dozen multiplied by the factor of twelve is a reference quantity of twelve units, and twelve multiplied by the unit cost of 10.00 is a movement value of 120.00.

records.name: The value of a goods movement: the priority chain
records.purpose: Produces the money value of one completed goods movement by consulting seven sources in a fixed order, each claiming part of the movement's valued quantity, so that a receipt is valued from its bill rather than from a guess and a return is valued at the price the goods left at.

operands.name: valued quantity of the movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the movement, as defined in the entities document of the domain
operands.constraints: may be zero; the chain still runs

operands.name: forced unit cost
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: may be absent, zero or non-zero

operands.name: as-of instant
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: when absent, the chain values as of now

operands.name: flag to ignore manual corrections
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: false by default

operands.name: flag to suppress the extra source
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: false by default

preconditions.condition: Exactly one movement is handed to the chain.
preconditions.otherwise: The chain is not run; each movement is valued on its own.

preconditions.condition: The movement is completed, or is being completed by the routine that calls the chain.
preconditions.otherwise: The value written would not be read, because a movement that is not completed carries all three classification flags false.

procedure: Set the remaining quantity and the valued quantity to the movement's valued quantity, set the value to zero, start an empty list of justification lines, and set the flag add extra to true unless the caller suppressed it.
Consult source zero, the manual correction, unless the caller asked to ignore manual corrections; a correction claims the whole remaining quantity and turns the flag add extra off.
Consult source one, the accounting documents, which are the vendor bills and vendor credit notes of the movement's purchase order line; subtract the quantity it claims from the remaining quantity.
Consult source two, production, when the movement belongs to a manufacturing order; it claims the whole remaining quantity.
Consult source three, the quotation, when the movement is linked to a purchase order line; subtract the quantity it claims.
Consult source four, returns, when the movement has an originating returned movement and that originating movement is outgoing; it claims the whole remaining quantity.
Consult source five, the product cost, whenever a remaining quantity is left; it claims the whole remainder.
Consult source six, the extra source of landed costs, only when the flag add extra is still on; it adds value without claiming any quantity.
Return the accumulated value, the valued quantity and the justification lines joined by newlines, in the order the sources were consulted.
records.formula: movement_value = Σ over the sources consulted, in order, of the value each source contributes ; remaining_quantity is reduced by the quantity each source claims ; the extra source adds its amount without claiming quantity

rounding.what: The value contributed by each source, and the total.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency for the stored value; the intermediate contributions are not rounded.
rounding.step: When the total is written onto the movement's value field.

result.name: value of the goods movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the movement's value field, together with the valued quantity and the human-readable justification.

edge_cases.case: Every source declines and the product has no unit cost.
edge_cases.outcome: The product-cost source applies a unit cost of zero, the movement is valued at zero and the goods enter stock at no value.

edge_cases.case: A manual correction exists on a movement that also carries landed costs.
edge_cases.outcome: The correction claims the whole quantity and suppresses the extra source, so the landed costs are not added on top; the value is exactly what the human typed.

edge_cases.case: Several manual corrections exist on the movement.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the latest by date, ties broken by the highest identifier, is used; earlier ones remain as history and nothing accumulates.

edge_cases.case: The valued quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Every proportional source contributes nothing and the value is zero, except the extra source, which can still add a landed cost amount.

edge_cases.case: The movement is both incoming and outgoing.
edge_cases.outcome: The valued quantity is the incoming quantity, because the incoming test is checked first.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of ten units with no bill, no purchase order line and no manufacturing order, for a product whose unit cost is 10.00
worked_examples.narrative: Sources zero to four all decline, so the whole remaining quantity of ten reaches the product-cost source, which contributes 10 × 10.00 = 100.00. The extra source finds no posted landed cost, so the value is 100.00.

worked_examples.description: The same receipt after a landed cost of 20.00 has been posted against it
worked_examples.narrative: The product-cost source contributes 100.00 for the ten units and the extra source adds the posted landed cost of 20.00 without claiming any quantity, giving 120.00.

worked_examples.description: The same receipt after a human adjusted its value to 150.00
worked_examples.narrative: The manual correction claims the whole quantity of ten, contributes 150.00 and turns the flag add extra off, so the landed cost of 20.00 is not added; the value is exactly 150.00.

records.name: Source zero of the priority chain: the manual correction
records.purpose: Lets a human state the final total value of one goods movement, landed costs included, overriding every other source of the chain.

operands.name: value of the latest valuation history record attached to the movement
operands.source: the valuation history record a human created for this movement
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: remaining quantity at that moment
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the chain, which has not yet consulted any other source
operands.constraints: equal to the movement's valued quantity

operands.name: as-of instant
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: records dated after it are ignored

preconditions.condition: The caller did not ask to ignore manual corrections.
preconditions.otherwise: The source is skipped and the chain continues with the accounting documents.

preconditions.condition: At least one valuation history record is attached to this movement whose date is not after the as-of instant.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing and the chain continues.

procedure: Select the valuation history records attached to this movement whose date is not after the as-of instant, when one is given.
Order them by date descending and, for equal dates, by identifier descending, and keep the first.
Contribute that record's value to the movement's value.
Claim the whole remaining quantity, so that no later source can claim any part of it.
Turn the flag add extra off, so that the extra source of landed costs is not consulted.
Add the justification line "Adjusted on _the date_ by _the user name_" and, when the record carries a description, a newline and that description.
records.formula: contributed_value = latest_valuation_history_record_value ; claimed_quantity = remaining_quantity ; add_extra = false

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency, applied when the valuation history record itself was written.
rounding.step: At the moment the human's value was stored on the valuation history record; the chain reuses it unrounded.

result.name: contribution of the manual correction
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the movement's value; the justification line is shown to the reader.

edge_cases.case: Several corrections exist on the same movement.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the latest by date, ties broken by the highest identifier, is used; there is no accumulation.

edge_cases.case: A correction is dated in the past.
edge_cases.outcome: A valuation as of an instant before that date does not see it; a valuation as of an instant exactly at that date does, because the lookup uses date not after the as-of instant.

edge_cases.case: The movement also carries posted landed costs.
edge_cases.outcome: They are not added, because the flag add extra is turned off; the ledger and the physical value then diverge by the landed cost amount until the next closing absorbs it.

edge_cases.case: The caller asked to ignore manual corrections.
edge_cases.outcome: The source is skipped entirely and the value is rebuilt from the other sources.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of ten units adjusted by hand to 150.00
worked_examples.narrative: The latest record by date and identifier carries 150.00, so it contributes 150.00, claims all ten units and switches the extra source off; the earlier record of 120.00 is ignored.

records.name: Source two of the priority chain: production
records.purpose: Values a finished-goods movement of a manufacturing order at the unit price the manufacturing cost computation wrote on it, so that the finished goods carry the cost of their components, their labour and their extra cost.

operands.name: remaining quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the chain, after the earlier sources have claimed their parts
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: unit price of the movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the manufacturing cost computation, which wrote it on the movement
operands.constraints: may be zero when the order has not been costed

preconditions.condition: The movement belongs to a manufacturing order.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing and the chain continues with the quotation source.

preconditions.condition: A remaining quantity is left after the earlier sources.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing.

procedure: Read the unit price the manufacturing cost computation wrote on the movement.
Multiply it by the remaining quantity.
Claim the whole remaining quantity.
Add the justification line "_the formatted value_ for _the quantity_ _the unit_ from _the manufacturing order name_".
records.formula: production_value = remaining_quantity × move_price_unit

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the accumulated movement value is written; the multiplication itself is not rounded.

result.name: contribution of the production source
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the movement's value.

edge_cases.case: The manufacturing order has not been costed, so the unit price is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The contribution is zero and the finished goods enter stock at no value.

edge_cases.case: The movement is a by-product movement.
edge_cases.outcome: Its unit price was set from the by-product cost share, so the same multiplication applies with that price.

edge_cases.case: The remaining quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The contribution is zero.

worked_examples.description: Ten finished units at a computed unit price of 47.80
worked_examples.narrative: Ten multiplied by 47.80 is 478.00, and the source claims all ten units, so no later source contributes.

records.name: Source four of the priority chain: returns
records.purpose: Values a return of goods at the price the goods left at, by taking the proportional share of the originating outgoing movement's value, rather than revaluing the goods at today's cost.

operands.name: value of the originating movement
operands.source: the outgoing movement this movement returns
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: valued quantity of the originating movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the originating movement
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: remaining quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the chain, after the earlier sources
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The movement has an originating returned movement.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing and the chain continues with the product cost.

preconditions.condition: That originating movement is outgoing.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing; a return of an incoming movement is valued by the later sources.

procedure: Read the value and the valued quantity of the originating outgoing movement.
When the originating valued quantity is zero, contribute zero.
Otherwise multiply the originating value by the remaining quantity and divide by the originating valued quantity.
Claim the whole remaining quantity.
Add the justification line "Value based on original move _the originating reference_".
records.formula: return_value = 0 when the originating valued quantity is zero ; return_value = origin_value × remaining_quantity ÷ origin_valued_quantity otherwise

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the accumulated movement value is written; the proportion itself is not rounded.

result.name: contribution of the return source
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the movement's value.

edge_cases.case: The originating movement has a valued quantity of zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The contribution is zero, whatever value the originating movement carries.

edge_cases.case: Only part of the delivery is returned.
edge_cases.outcome: The value is the proportional share, so returning three of ten units delivered at 100.00 gives 30.00.

edge_cases.case: The originating movement was itself valued at zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The return is valued at zero.

edge_cases.case: The originating movement is incoming rather than outgoing.
edge_cases.outcome: The source declines and the goods are valued by the product-cost source at today's cost.

worked_examples.description: Returning three units of a delivery of ten valued at 100.00
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred multiplied by three and divided by ten is 30.00, the exact share of the delivery the three units represent.

worked_examples.description: Returning the whole of a delivery of ten valued at 108.00
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred and eight multiplied by ten and divided by ten is 108.00, so the return reverses the delivery exactly.

records.name: Source five of the priority chain: the product cost
records.purpose: Values whatever quantity the earlier sources left unclaimed at a unit cost chosen from the product, the lot, the valuation history or the movement itself, which is the source that always answers.

operands.name: remaining quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the chain, after the earlier sources
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: forced unit cost
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: may be absent or zero

operands.name: unit cost of the product
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the product, at full floating precision
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: unit cost of the lot
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the lot carried by the movement, when the product is valuated by lot and the movement carries exactly one lot
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: unit cost as of the as-of instant
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the valuation history of the product under standard price
operands.constraints: used only when an as-of instant is given

operands.name: value and valued quantity of the movement itself
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the reference unit of measure
operands.source: the movement, under first in first out with an as-of instant
operands.constraints: the valued quantity may be zero

preconditions.condition: A remaining quantity is left after the earlier sources.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing.

preconditions.condition: A unit cost can be determined by one of the four ordered tests, or the product carries a unit cost.
preconditions.otherwise: The chosen unit cost is empty or zero, so the product's current unit cost is used, which may itself be zero.

procedure: When an as-of instant is given and the costing method is `standard`, take the forced cost if one was given, else the product's current unit cost, else the product's unit cost as of that instant from the valuation history.
Otherwise, when the product is valuated by lot and the movement carries exactly one lot, take that lot's cost.

Otherwise, when no forced cost was given, an as-of instant is given and the costing method is `fifo`, take the movement's own current value divided by its valued quantity, or zero when that valued quantity is zero.
Otherwise take whatever forced cost was given.
When the chosen unit cost is empty or zero, use the product's current unit cost instead.
Multiply the chosen unit cost by the remaining quantity and claim the whole remaining quantity.
Add the justification line "_the quantity_ _the reference unit name_ at product's cost".
records.formula: cost_value = ( chosen_unit_cost or product_unit_cost ) × remaining_quantity

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency for the value; the unit cost itself is used at full floating precision.
rounding.step: When the accumulated movement value is written.

result.name: contribution of the product-cost source
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the movement's value.

edge_cases.case: The product has no unit cost and no other source answered.
edge_cases.outcome: The contribution is zero and the goods enter stock at no value.

edge_cases.case: The product is valuated by lot and the movement carries more than one lot.
edge_cases.outcome: The lot branch does not apply; the chain falls through to the later tests and ends at the product's unit cost.

edge_cases.case: An as-of instant is given under first in first out.
edge_cases.outcome: The movement's own stored value divided by its valued quantity is used, so re-evaluating a past movement does not drift with the product's current cost.

edge_cases.case: An as-of instant is given under standard price and no valuation history exists.
edge_cases.outcome: The product's current unit cost is used.

worked_examples.description: Ten units valued at the product's unit cost of 10.00
worked_examples.narrative: No forced cost, no lot and no as-of instant, so the product's unit cost of 10.00 is used and ten units give 100.00.

worked_examples.description: Re-evaluating a past receipt under first in first out as of an instant
worked_examples.narrative: Under first in first out with an as-of instant, the unit cost is the movement's own value of 120.00 divided by its valued quantity of ten, which is 12.00, so the contribution is 120.00 and not the 165.00 today's cost would give.

records.name: Source one of the priority chain: value from vendor bills
records.purpose: Values the part of a receipt that a posted vendor bill has already priced, so that the goods enter stock at the price actually invoiced rather than at the price ordered.

operands.name: billed quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the bill and credit-note lines of the movement's purchase order line, converted from the line unit of measure
operands.constraints: vendor bills add, vendor credit notes subtract

operands.name: billed value
operands.source: the same lines, each converted at the document's own rate
operands.constraints: vendor bills add, vendor credit notes subtract

operands.name: absorbed quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the valued quantities of the other movements of the same purchase order line that are earlier than this one
operands.constraints: incoming and drop-shipment movements add, outgoing movements subtract

operands.name: remaining quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the chain, after the manual correction
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: as-of instant
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: reduced to a plain date, because bill lines carry a date without a time

preconditions.condition: The movement is linked to a purchase order line.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing.

preconditions.condition: The billed quantity is positive.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing.

preconditions.condition: The billed quantity is greater than the absorbed quantity.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing, because the bill has already been consumed by earlier movements.

procedure: When the as-of instant carries a time component, reduce it to a plain date, because bill lines carry a date without a time.
Walk every bill line of the purchase order line, skipping a line whose date is after the as-of date and a line whose document is not posted.
For a vendor bill line, add its quantity converted into the product reference unit to the billed quantity and its value to the billed value; for a vendor credit-note line, subtract both.
Stop and contribute nothing when the billed quantity is not positive.

Compute the absorbed quantity by walking the movements of the purchase order line, skipping this movement itself, skipping movements of a different product and skipping movements later than this one, adding the valued quantity of each earlier incoming or drop-shipment movement and subtracting the valued quantity of each earlier outgoing movement, which because the subtraction is applied to the negation of the valued quantity increases the absorbed quantity.
Stop and contribute nothing when the billed quantity is not greater than the absorbed quantity.
Cut the absorbed part away, keeping the value proportional, to obtain the available value and the available quantity.

Claim the smaller of the remaining quantity and the available quantity, contributing the whole available value when the remaining quantity is at least the available quantity and the proportional part otherwise.
Add the justification line "_the formatted value_ for _the available quantity_ _the reference unit name_ from _the list of bill display names_".
records.formula: available_value = billed_value × ( billed_quantity − absorbed_quantity ) ÷ billed_quantity ; available_quantity = billed_quantity − absorbed_quantity ; claimed_quantity = min( remaining_quantity , available_quantity ) ; contributed_value = available_value when remaining_quantity ≥ available_quantity ; contributed_value = remaining_quantity × available_value ÷ available_quantity otherwise

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency; each bill line's value was already rounded to the company currency when it was read.
rounding.step: On each bill line as it is read, and again when the accumulated movement value is written; the proportional cuts in between are not rounded.

result.name: contribution of the accounting-document source
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the movement's value; the identifiers of the bill lines consulted are remembered for the justification.

edge_cases.case: A bill line is not posted.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped, so a draft bill never influences the value of a receipt.

edge_cases.case: A bill line is dated after the as-of date.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped, so a past valuation is not disturbed by a later bill.

edge_cases.case: A vendor credit note brings the billed quantity down to zero or below.
edge_cases.outcome: The source contributes nothing and the chain falls through to the quotation source or the product cost.

edge_cases.case: An earlier outgoing movement exists on the same purchase order line.
edge_cases.outcome: Its valued quantity increases the absorbed quantity, because the subtraction is applied to the negation of the valued quantity.

edge_cases.case: A movement of the same purchase order line carries the same date but a higher identifier.
edge_cases.outcome: It counts as later and does not absorb any of the billed quantity.

edge_cases.case: The remaining quantity is smaller than the available quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the proportional part of the available value is contributed and the rest stays available for a later movement of the same purchase order line.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of ten units against a bill of ten units at 12.00, with nothing absorbed
worked_examples.narrative: The available quantity is ten minus zero, and the available value is 120.00 multiplied by ten divided by ten, so the whole 120.00 is contributed for the ten units.

worked_examples.description: A second receipt of four units when six of the ten billed were already absorbed
worked_examples.narrative: The available quantity is ten minus six, which is four, and the available value is 120.00 multiplied by four divided by ten, which is 48.00; the remaining quantity of four equals the available quantity, so the whole 48.00 is contributed.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of two units against an available quantity of four
worked_examples.narrative: The remaining quantity of two is smaller than the available quantity of four, so the contribution is two multiplied by 48.00 divided by four, which is 24.00, and two units remain available for a later movement.

records.name: Value of one vendor bill line in the company currency
records.purpose: Converts the subtotal of a bill line into the company currency at the rate that was in force for that bill, so that a receipt is valued at the historical rate and not at today's rate.

operands.name: subtotal of the bill line
operands.source: the bill or credit-note line
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: currency rate stored on the line
operands.unit_or_currency: a ratio of document currency to company currency
operands.source: the line itself, so that the rate of that bill is used
operands.constraints: strictly greater than zero

preconditions.condition: The line carries a currency rate.
preconditions.otherwise: The conversion cannot be performed and the line contributes nothing.

preconditions.condition: The company currency is known.
preconditions.otherwise: The rounding cannot be applied.

procedure: Divide the line subtotal by the currency rate stored on the line.
Round the quotient to the company currency, half away from zero.
Add the rounded amount to the billed value for a vendor bill line, or subtract it for a vendor credit-note line.
records.formula: bill_line_value = round_to_currency( line_subtotal ÷ line_currency_rate )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: Immediately after the division, before the amount is accumulated into the billed value.

result.name: value of the bill line
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the billed value used by the accounting-document source.

edge_cases.case: The document currency and the company currency are the same.
edge_cases.outcome: The stored rate is one and the subtotal passes through unchanged apart from the rounding.

edge_cases.case: The line belongs to a vendor credit note.
edge_cases.outcome: The rounded amount is subtracted rather than added, and the quantity is subtracted as well.

edge_cases.case: The subtotal is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The converted value is zero.

worked_examples.description: A bill line of 120.00 in a currency worth one point one company units
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred and twenty divided by one point one is 109.090909…, which rounds to 109.09 at two decimal places, half away from zero.

worked_examples.description: A bill line already in the company currency
worked_examples.narrative: The rate is one, so the subtotal passes through as 120.00.

records.name: Quantity of one vendor bill line in the product reference unit
records.purpose: Brings the quantity of a bill line onto the same scale as the movement's valued quantity, so that billed and received quantities can be compared.

operands.name: quantity of the bill line
operands.source: the bill or credit-note line
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: line unit of measure
operands.source: the bill or credit-note line
operands.constraints: must belong to the same category as the product reference unit

operands.name: product reference unit of measure
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: the scale every valuation quantity uses

preconditions.condition: The line unit of measure and the product reference unit of measure belong to the same category.
preconditions.otherwise: No conversion is possible and the line cannot be compared with the movement.

procedure: Convert the line quantity from the line unit of measure into the product reference unit of measure, using the factor of each.
Add the converted quantity to the billed quantity for a vendor bill line, or subtract it for a vendor credit-note line.
records.formula: bill_line_quantity = convert( line_quantity , line_unit_of_measure → product_reference_unit )

rounding.precision: The Product Unit decimal precision, or the rounding step of the reference unit of measure.
rounding.step: After the conversion, when the quantity is accumulated and compared.

result.name: quantity of the bill line
result.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the billed quantity used by the accounting-document source.

edge_cases.case: The line is already expressed in the reference unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity passes through unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The line belongs to a vendor credit note.
edge_cases.outcome: The converted quantity is subtracted from the billed quantity.

edge_cases.case: The line quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The converted quantity is zero and the line contributes nothing to the billed quantity.

worked_examples.description: Five packs of six units billed for a product whose reference unit is the unit
worked_examples.narrative: Five packs multiplied by the pack factor of six give thirty units in the product reference unit.

records.name: Source three of the priority chain: value from a purchase order line
records.purpose: Values the part of a receipt that no bill has priced yet, at the price of the purchase order line brought into the company currency at the movement's date.

operands.name: unit price of the purchase order line for stock
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the purchase unit price computation, with the conversion date forced to the movement's date
operands.constraints: rounded to the Product Price decimal precision

operands.name: remaining quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the chain, after the accounting documents and production
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: quantity of the movement
operands.source: the movement
operands.constraints: converted into the product reference unit before the clamp

operands.name: cost ratio
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the claimed quantity by default; a manufacturing kit installation may replace it by the kit price unit
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The movement is linked to a purchase order line.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing and the chain continues with the returns source.

preconditions.condition: A remaining quantity is left after the earlier sources.
preconditions.otherwise: The source contributes nothing.

procedure: Compute the purchase order line's unit price for stock in the company currency, with the conversion date forced to the movement's date.
Convert the movement quantity into the product reference unit and clamp the claimed quantity to the smaller of it and the remaining quantity.
Take the cost ratio, which is the claimed quantity itself unless a manufacturing kit installation replaces it.
Multiply the purchase unit price by the cost ratio to obtain the contribution.
Add the justification line "_the formatted value_ for _the quantity_ _the reference unit name_ from _the purchase order display name_ (not billed)".
records.formula: claimed_quantity = min( remaining_quantity , convert( move_quantity , move_unit → product_reference_unit ) ) ; quotation_value = purchase_unit_price × cost_ratio

rounding.what: The contributed value; the purchase unit price was already rounded by its own computation.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency for the value, and the Product Price decimal precision for the unit price.
rounding.step: The unit price at the last step of its own computation; the value when the accumulated movement value is written.

result.name: contribution of the quotation source
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated into the movement's value.

edge_cases.case: Part of the movement was already claimed by a bill.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the remaining quantity is claimed here, so the receipt is valued partly at the billed price and partly at the ordered price.

edge_cases.case: The product is a kit.
edge_cases.outcome: The cost ratio is replaced by the kit price unit, so the value is recombined from the components rather than taken from the order line.

edge_cases.case: The movement quantity converted to the reference unit is smaller than the remaining quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The claim is limited to the movement quantity.

edge_cases.case: The purchase order line carries a discount.
edge_cases.outcome: The discounted unit price is the starting point of the unit price computation.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of two packs of six against a line ordering five packs at 60.00 per pack
worked_examples.narrative: The unit price for stock is 10.00 per unit, the claimed quantity is the smaller of twelve and twelve, and 10.00 multiplied by twelve is 120.00.

records.name: The unit price of a purchase order line for stock
records.purpose: Turns the price a purchase order line carries into a cost per unit of the product reference unit in the company currency, capitalising the non-deductible taxes, so that the quotation source of the priority chain has one comparable figure.

operands.name: discounted unit price of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the order currency per line unit of measure
operands.source: the purchase order line, net of its discount
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: taxes of the line
operands.source: the purchase order line
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: quantity of the line
operands.source: the purchase order line
operands.constraints: one is used when the quantity is zero

operands.name: line unit factor and reference unit factor
operands.unit_or_currency: ratios to the reference unit of measure
operands.source: the line unit of measure and the product reference unit of measure
operands.constraints: strictly greater than zero

operands.name: order currency and company currency
operands.source: the purchase order and the company
operands.constraints: may be the same

operands.name: conversion date
operands.source: the date forced by the caller, which is the movement's date when the caller is the valuation engine, else the order date, else today
operands.constraints: must be a valid date

operands.name: Product Price decimal precision
operands.source: the named decimal precision record for product prices
operands.constraints: two by default

preconditions.condition: The line carries a unit price.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is zero and the whole computation yields zero.

preconditions.condition: The line unit of measure and the product reference unit belong to the same category.
preconditions.otherwise: The third step cannot be applied and the price cannot be brought onto the reference scale.

procedure: Start from the line's discounted unit price.

When the line carries taxes, take the quantity of the line or one when it is zero, apply the taxes to the price for that quantity with a global rounding, keep the part that represents non-deductible taxes to be capitalised into the cost, and divide it by that quantity.
When the line unit of measure differs from the product reference unit, divide the price by the line unit factor and multiply it by the reference unit factor.
When the order currency differs from the company currency, convert the price at the conversion date without rounding.
Round the result to the nearest multiple of ten raised to the negative Product Price decimal precision, ties away from zero.
records.formula: step 1: price = discounted_unit_price ; step 2: if the line carries taxes: quantity_for_tax = line_quantity or 1 ; price = total_void( taxes applied to price for quantity_for_tax , rounded globally ) ÷ quantity_for_tax ; step 3: if the line unit of measure differs from the product reference unit: price = price ÷ line_unit_factor × reference_unit_factor ; step 4: if the order currency differs from the company currency: price = convert( price , order_currency → company_currency , at the conversion date , without rounding ) ; step 5: price = round_half_up( price , 10^(−Product Price precision) )

rounding.what: The unit price of the line for stock purposes.
rounding.precision: The Product Price decimal precision, so a step of one hundredth when that precision is two.
rounding.step: At the fifth and last step, after the tax capitalisation, the unit conversion and the currency conversion; the currency conversion itself is performed without rounding.

result.name: purchase unit price for stock
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the quotation source of the priority chain and written onto the movement's unit price when the movement is created from the order.

edge_cases.case: The line carries no taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: The second step is skipped and the discounted unit price goes straight to the unit conversion.

edge_cases.case: The line quantity is zero and the line carries taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: A quantity of one is used for the tax computation, so the capitalised amount is the tax on one unit.

edge_cases.case: The line unit of measure is the product reference unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The third step is skipped.

edge_cases.case: The order currency is the company currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The fourth step is skipped.

edge_cases.case: The taxes are fully deductible.
edge_cases.outcome: The part to be capitalised is zero, so the second step leaves the price unchanged apart from the division by the quantity.

worked_examples.description: Five packs of six units at 60.00 per pack, no taxes, in the company currency
worked_examples.narrative: There are no taxes, so the second step is skipped. The third step divides 60.00 by the pack factor of six and multiplies by the reference factor of one, giving 10.00 per unit. The currencies match, and rounding at two decimal places leaves 10.00.

worked_examples.description: The same line valued against a receipt of two packs
worked_examples.narrative: A receipt of two packs has a reference quantity of twelve, so its value from the quotation source is 10.00 multiplied by twelve, which is 120.00.

records.name: Valuing a set of goods movements on completion
records.purpose: Writes the value of every qualifying movement of a completion and brings the unit costs of the products and lots touched up to date, which is the single entry point called once for the outgoing movements before the state change and once for the incoming movements after it.

operands.name: set of goods movements
operands.source: the completion of a transfer, the creation of a movement already completed, or a revaluation event
operands.constraints: movements that do not qualify are silently skipped

operands.name: correction quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the caller, optionally, when the quantity of an already-completed outgoing movement has just changed
operands.constraints: a signed amount; absent for an incoming movement

operands.name: incremental unit cost recomputation flag
operands.source: the caller; it is on only when no outgoing movement was valued in the same completion
operands.constraints: when off, the full unit cost path runs

preconditions.condition: No precondition; movements that do not qualify are silently skipped.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is written for them.

preconditions.condition: For an incoming movement of a product with valuation by lot, every line carries a lot or serial number.
preconditions.otherwise: The routine refuses with the message "A lot/serial number is required for product '_the product display name_' as it has lot valuation enabled."

procedure: Start three empty collections: the products to recompute, the lots to recompute, and a map from product to the first in first out quantity already processed in this call.
Group the movements by company and take each company in turn, with that company in scope.
For each company, start two empty maps: the extra value per product and the extra quantity per product.

For an incoming movement, add its product to the products to recompute; refuse when the product is valuated by lot and any line carries no lot or serial number; otherwise add every lot of its lines to the lots to recompute.

Set the incoming movement's value to the result of the priority chain evaluated with elevated privileges, and, when the incremental flag is on and the product is storable, accumulate its value into the extra value of the product and its valued quantity into the extra quantity, then continue to the next movement.
Skip a movement that does not count as outgoing.
When a correction quantity was supplied and the previous quantity is non-zero, scale the existing value and continue to the next movement.
Otherwise value the outgoing movement by the branch its product requires: valuation by lot, first in first out, or standard price and average cost.
Recompute the unit cost of every product in the products-to-recompute collection, passing the extra value and extra quantity maps.
Recompute the unit cost of every lot in the lots-to-recompute collection.
records.formula: for each qualifying movement: move_value = the branch value ; the products and lots touched are then recomputed with the extra value and extra quantity maps

rounding.what: Each movement's value as it is written.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: At the moment each movement's value field is written; the unit costs written afterwards keep full floating precision.

result.name: value of every qualifying movement, and the refreshed unit costs
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the company currency per reference unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on each movement's value field, on each product's unit cost and on each lot's unit cost.

edge_cases.case: A movement is both incoming and outgoing.
edge_cases.outcome: The incoming branch runs and ends with a continuation, so the outgoing branch is skipped for that movement.

edge_cases.case: The batch spans several companies.
edge_cases.outcome: The movements are grouped by company and re-scoped to each company before being valued, so a batch spanning companies is valued correctly.

edge_cases.case: Several outgoing movements of the same product are in the batch under first in first out.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity already processed for that product is subtracted from the stack size, so the second movement does not re-consume the same units.

edge_cases.case: An outgoing movement was valued in the same completion.
edge_cases.outcome: The incremental fast path for the unit cost is not enabled, and the full path runs instead.

edge_cases.case: A movement is created already in the completed state.
edge_cases.outcome: The outgoing ones are valued by the creation hook; the incoming ones are valued when their lines are created, because creating a line triggers a full revaluation of an incoming parent.

worked_examples.description: A completion of one delivery of ten units and one receipt of ten units for the same product using average cost
worked_examples.narrative: The outgoing movement is valued before the state change at the product's unit cost, ten multiplied by 10.00 giving 100.00. The receipt is valued after the state change at 120.00. Because an outgoing movement was valued in the same completion, the incremental fast path is not enabled and the full unit cost path runs.

records.name: Value of an outgoing movement under valuation by lot
records.purpose: Values goods leaving stock at the cost of the very lots that leave, so that a product whose lots were bought at different prices reports the cost of the lot actually shipped.

operands.name: quantity of each line in the reference unit
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the lines of the outgoing movement, converted from the line unit of measure
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: unit cost of the lot carried by the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the lot record
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: unit cost of the product
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the product, used for a line that carries no lot
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The product is valuated by lot.
preconditions.otherwise: The movement is valued by the first in first out branch or by the standard price and average cost branch instead.

preconditions.condition: The movement counts as outgoing.
preconditions.otherwise: The movement is skipped by this branch.

procedure: Take each line of the movement in turn.
Convert the line quantity into the product reference unit.
Multiply it by the unit cost of the lot the line carries, or, for a line that carries no lot, by the product's unit cost.
Sum the products over all the lines and write the sum as the movement's value.
records.formula: move_value = Σ over the lines of the movement of line_quantity_in_reference_unit × ( lot_unit_cost when the line carries a lot , else product_unit_cost )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the summed value is written onto the movement.

result.name: value of the outgoing movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the movement's value field.

edge_cases.case: A line carries no lot.
edge_cases.outcome: That line is valued at the product's unit cost, which is the aggregate of the lots' costs.

edge_cases.case: A lot has a unit cost of zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The line contributes zero.

edge_cases.case: The movement is incoming.
edge_cases.outcome: This branch does not apply; an incoming movement of a lot-valuated product is refused when any line carries no lot.

worked_examples.description: A delivery of two lines, six units of a lot costing 10.00 and four units of a lot costing 12.00
worked_examples.narrative: Six multiplied by 10.00 is 60.00 and four multiplied by 12.00 is 48.00; the sum written on the movement is 108.00.

records.name: Value of an outgoing movement under first in first out
records.purpose: Values goods leaving stock at the cost of the oldest units still on hand, threading a per-product counter through the batch so that several deliveries validated together consume the stack in sequence.

operands.name: valued quantity of the movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the movement
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: quantity already processed for this product in this call
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the map the routine threads through the batch
operands.constraints: starts at zero for the first movement of the product

operands.name: stack of incoming movements
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of movements with their values and valued quantities
operands.source: the first in first out stack building rule
operands.constraints: may be empty

preconditions.condition: The costing method of the product is `fifo`.
preconditions.otherwise: The movement is valued by the lot branch or by the standard price and average cost branch instead.

preconditions.condition: The product is not valuated by lot.
preconditions.otherwise: The lot branch takes precedence.

procedure: Subtract the quantity already processed for this product in this call from the stack size, so that the units consumed by an earlier movement of the same batch are not offered again.
Value the movement's valued quantity against the resulting stack, oldest first.
Write the accumulated cost as the movement's value.
Add the movement's valued quantity to the quantity already processed for that product.
records.formula: move_value = fifo_value( product , movement_valued_quantity , with the stack size reduced by the quantity already processed in this call )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the accumulated cost is written onto the movement; the per-layer arithmetic is not rounded.

result.name: value of the outgoing movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the movement's value field.

edge_cases.case: Two deliveries of the same product are validated together.
edge_cases.outcome: The first consumes the oldest layers and the second starts where the first stopped, because the quantity already processed is subtracted from the stack size.

edge_cases.case: The quantity asked for exceeds everything ever received.
edge_cases.outcome: The remainder is extrapolated from the last movement used, or from the product's unit cost when no movement was used.

edge_cases.case: The stack is empty because the quantity on hand is not positive.
edge_cases.outcome: The whole quantity is extrapolated at the product's unit cost, or at the unit price of the last incoming movement when an as-of instant is given.

edge_cases.case: The valued quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The value is zero and the quantity already processed does not move.

worked_examples.description: Two deliveries of the same product validated together against a stack of sixty-eight at 15.00 and one hundred and forty at 15.50
worked_examples.narrative: The first delivery takes sixty-eight units at 15.00, which is 1 020.00, and twenty-six units at 15.50, which is 403.00, for 1 423.00. The counter records ninety-four. The second delivery starts at that point and takes twenty units at 15.50, which is 310.00.

records.name: Value of an outgoing movement under standard price or average cost
records.purpose: Values goods leaving stock at the product's current unit cost, which under standard price is the input the operator set and under average cost is whatever the last replay left behind.

operands.name: valued quantity of the movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the movement
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative in the sense that stock goes negative

operands.name: unit cost of the product
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the product, at full floating precision
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The costing method of the product is `standard` or `average`.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other branches applies.

preconditions.condition: The product is not valuated by lot.
preconditions.otherwise: The lot branch takes precedence.

procedure: Read the product's current unit cost at full floating precision.
Multiply it by the movement's valued quantity.
Write the product as the movement's value.
records.formula: move_value = product_unit_cost × movement_valued_quantity

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the value is written onto the movement; the unit cost keeps its full floating precision in the multiplication.

result.name: value of the outgoing movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the movement's value field.

edge_cases.case: The quantity on hand is zero or negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The movement is still valued at the product's unit cost and the quantity on hand and the total value both go further negative.

edge_cases.case: The unit cost is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The movement is valued at zero.

edge_cases.case: The product uses average cost and a receipt is validated in the same completion.
edge_cases.outcome: The outgoing movements are valued before the state change, so they use the unit cost as it stood before the receipt.

worked_examples.description: A delivery of fifteen units of a product whose average unit cost is 12.50
worked_examples.narrative: Fifteen multiplied by 12.50 is 187.50, written on the movement.

worked_examples.description: A delivery of fifty units against a quantity on hand of zero, at a unit cost of 8.00
worked_examples.narrative: Fifty multiplied by 8.00 is 400.00; the quantity on hand becomes minus fifty and the total value minus 400.00.

records.name: Outgoing correction: scaling the value of a completed outgoing movement
records.purpose: Rewrites the value of an already-completed outgoing movement whose quantity has changed by scaling the existing value, so that the first in first out stack is not consumed twice and today's average is not applied to an earlier delivery.

operands.name: new quantity of the movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the movement after the edit
operands.constraints: may be greater or smaller than before

operands.name: correction quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the sum of the per-line quantity deltas over the lines not excluded for valuation
operands.constraints: signed; positive for an increase, negative for a decrease

operands.name: old value of the movement
operands.source: the movement's value field before the edit
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

preconditions.condition: A correction quantity was supplied by the caller.
preconditions.otherwise: The routine values the movement from the costing method instead.

preconditions.condition: The previous quantity, that is the new quantity minus the correction quantity, is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: No scaling is possible and the routine falls through to the ordinary costing computation.

procedure: Compute the previous quantity as the new movement quantity minus the correction quantity.
Stop and fall through to the ordinary costing computation when the previous quantity is zero.
Compute the ratio as the correction quantity divided by the previous quantity.
Add the ratio multiplied by the old value to the old value, which is the same as multiplying the old value by the new quantity divided by the previous quantity.
Write the result as the movement's new value.
records.formula: previous_quantity = new_move_quantity − correction_quantity ; ratio = correction_quantity ÷ previous_quantity ; new_value = old_value + ratio × old_value = old_value × ( 1 + correction_quantity ÷ previous_quantity ) = old_value × new_move_quantity ÷ previous_quantity

rounding.what: The new value of the movement.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the scaled value is written onto the movement; the ratio is not rounded.

result.name: new value of the outgoing movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the movement's value field, replacing the old value.

edge_cases.case: The previous quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: No scaling is possible and the routine falls through to the ordinary costing computation.

edge_cases.case: The correction quantity is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is negative and the value falls proportionally.

edge_cases.case: The correction quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is zero and the value is unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The old value is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The scaled value stays zero whatever the ratio.

worked_examples.description: A delivery of ten units valued at 100.00 corrected upwards to twelve units
worked_examples.narrative: The previous quantity is twelve minus two, which is ten. The ratio is two divided by ten, which is 0.2. The new value is 100.00 plus 0.2 multiplied by 100.00, which is 120.00.

worked_examples.description: The same delivery corrected downwards to eight units
worked_examples.narrative: The previous quantity is eight minus minus two, which is ten. The ratio is minus two divided by ten, which is minus 0.2. The new value is 100.00 minus 20.00, which is 80.00.

records.name: Choosing the revaluation call after a change
records.purpose: Decides, for each event that can change a movement's value, whether a full revaluation runs or an outgoing correction scales the existing value, which is what keeps the stored values of the domain consistent.

operands.name: event that changed a record
operands.source: a line added to or edited on a movement, a vendor bill posted, a purchase order line changed, a landed cost validated, or a valuation history record created
operands.constraints: no other event may change a movement's value

operands.name: per-line quantity deltas
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the lines of an outgoing movement that are not excluded for valuation
operands.constraints: summed into the correction quantity

preconditions.condition: The event is one of the six listed situations.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is revalued; a movement's value, once written, is changed by nothing else.

procedure: When a line is added to or edited on an incoming movement, run a full revaluation with no correction quantity.
When a line is added to or edited on an outgoing movement, run the routine with a correction quantity equal to the sum of the per-line quantity deltas over the lines not excluded for valuation.
When a vendor bill is posted, run a full revaluation of every incoming or drop-shipment movement reachable from the bill's lines.
