worked_examples.narrative: The price difference account is debited 10.00 and the inventory valuation account credited 10.00. The bill's own lines had debited the inventory valuation account 100.00, so the inventory asset is debited by 90.00 net, which is ten units at the standard cost of 9.00, and the 10.00 overpayment is expensed to the price difference account.

records.name: The two sides the inventory valuation closing compares
records.purpose: Defines the physical value and the ledger value of an inventory valuation account, whose difference is what the closing entry corrects.

operands.name: total value of each product as of the report date
operands.source: the valuation engine, by the batch routine of the product's costing method
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: inventory valuation account of each product
operands.source: the product's category for that company, falling back to the company's account
operands.constraints: groups the products into accounts

operands.name: balance of each posted journal item on that account
operands.source: the general ledger, for the company and dated not after the report date
operands.constraints: posted items only

preconditions.condition: Each product resolves an inventory valuation account.
preconditions.otherwise: The product's value is attributed to the company's fallback account.

preconditions.condition: The report date is not before the last closing date.
preconditions.otherwise: The closing is refused with the message "It exists closing entries after the selected date. Cancel them before generate an entry prior to them".

procedure: Sum, for each inventory valuation account, the total value as of the report date of every product whose inventory valuation account is that account, to obtain the physical value.
Sum, for the same account, the balances of the posted journal items of the company dated not after the report date, to obtain the ledger value.
Take the difference of the two as the amount the closing entry must correct.
records.formula: physical_value( account ) = Σ over the products whose inventory valuation account is that account of total_value( product , as of the report date ) ; ledger_value( account ) = Σ over the posted journal items on that account , of the company , dated not after the report date , of line_balance

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the balance to post is compared to zero and when the items are written.

result.name: physical value and ledger value per account
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the inventory valuation report and consumed by the three parts of the closing.

edge_cases.case: A product has a negative total value.
edge_cases.outcome: It reduces the physical value of its account, which is how negative stock reaches the closing as a variation.

edge_cases.case: A journal item on the account is not posted.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not counted in the ledger value.

edge_cases.case: A journal item is dated after the report date.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not counted.

edge_cases.case: A kit product sits in the category.
edge_cases.outcome: Its computed total value is forced to zero, so its components are not counted twice.

worked_examples.description: One account holding goods worth 250.00 with an empty ledger balance
worked_examples.narrative: The physical value of 250.00 against a ledger value of 0.00 leaves 250.00 for the closing entry to correct.

worked_examples.description: The same account a month later, the goods now worth 310.00 and the ledger standing at 250.00
worked_examples.narrative: Three hundred and ten minus two hundred and fifty leaves 60.00 to correct.

records.name: Closing part one: the location reclassification balance
records.purpose: Moves the value of goods that left the valued perimeter through a location carrying its own valuation account off the inventory asset and onto that location's account.

operands.name: value of each movement that went out into such a location
operands.source: the movements whose outgoing flag is set and whose destination is one of those locations, grouped by destination location and product category
operands.constraints: restricted to storable products with the `periodic` valuation mode

operands.name: value of each movement that came back out of such a location
operands.source: the movements whose incoming flag is set and whose source is one of those locations, grouped by source location and product category
operands.constraints: restricted the same way

operands.name: last closing instant
operands.source: the last closing instant rule
operands.constraints: absent when no closing exists

operands.name: report date
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: movements dated after it are excluded

preconditions.condition: The locations selected belong to the company and carry a valuation account.
preconditions.otherwise: No pair is produced for a location without a valuation account.

preconditions.condition: The movements are restricted to storable products whose valuation mode is `periodic`.
preconditions.otherwise: A perpetual-valuation movement would be counted twice, because it already posted its own entry.

procedure: Select the locations of the company that carry a valuation account, restricted by the caller's location condition when one is given.

Build the base movement filter: the product is storable and its valuation mode is `periodic`; add the condition date after the last closing instant when a previous closing exists, and the condition date not after the report date when one is given.
Sum the values of the movements whose outgoing flag is set and whose destination is one of those locations, grouped by destination location and product category.
Sum the values of the movements whose incoming flag is set and whose source is one of those locations, grouped by source location and product category.

Build a balance for each pair of a location account and an inventory valuation account, the latter being the category's account for that company falling back to the company's account, as the goods that went out into the location minus the goods that came back from it.

Produce, for each pair whose balance is not exactly zero, a balanced pair of journal items debiting the location account and crediting the inventory valuation account, labelled "Closing: Location Reclassification - [_the location account display name_]".
records.formula: balance( location_account , valuation_account ) = Σ value of the movements that went out into that location − Σ value of the movements that came back from that location

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the balance is compared to zero and when each journal item is written.

result.name: the location reclassification journal items
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Proposed as part of the closing entry and, through the extra balance, taken into account by the two later parts.

edge_cases.case: The balance is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: No pair is produced for that combination.

edge_cases.case: The balance is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The two accounts swap and the balance is replaced by its absolute value.

edge_cases.case: No previous closing exists.
edge_cases.outcome: The date condition after the last closing instant is not added, so every movement counts.

edge_cases.case: A movement belongs to a product using perpetual valuation.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded, because its own entry already posted.

edge_cases.case: An inter-company transit location is involved.
edge_cases.outcome: It is outside the valued perimeter, because it has a `transit` usage but no company.

records.name: Closing part two: the global stock variation balance
records.purpose: Brings each inventory valuation account's ledger balance to the physical value of the goods it represents, which is the entry that makes the ledger agree with the inventory.

operands.name: physical value of the account
operands.source: the valuation engine, supplied by the caller when the report already computed it
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: ledger value of the account
operands.source: the posted journal items on that account, of the company, dated not after the report date
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: extra balance of the account
operands.source: the sum of debit minus credit over the items already proposed by part one on that account
operands.constraints: zero when part one proposed nothing

operands.name: variation account
operands.source: the account's variation account, falling back to the company's default expense account
operands.constraints: when both are empty the account is skipped entirely

preconditions.condition: The account carries a variation account, or the company carries a default expense account.
preconditions.otherwise: The account is skipped entirely and no pair is produced for it.

preconditions.condition: The balance is not zero for the company currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The account is skipped.

procedure: Compute the extra balance of each account as the sum of debit minus credit over the items already proposed by part one.
Take the physical value per account, supplied by the caller when the report already computed it and computed now otherwise, and the ledger value per account.
For each account appearing in either, take its variation account, falling back to the company's default expense account, and skip the account entirely when both are empty.
Compute the balance as the physical value minus the ledger value minus the extra balance.
Skip when the balance is zero for the company currency.

Produce a balanced pair of journal items debiting the inventory valuation account and crediting the variation account by that balance, labelled "Closing: Stock Variation Global for company [_the company display name_]".
records.formula: extra_balance( account ) = Σ ( debit − credit ) over the proposed items on that account ; balance = physical_value( account ) − ledger_value( account ) − extra_balance( account )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the balance is tested against zero and when each journal item is written.

result.name: the global stock variation journal items
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Proposed as part of the closing entry.

edge_cases.case: The balance is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The two accounts swap and the balance is replaced by its absolute value, so the variation account is debited and the inventory valuation account credited.

edge_cases.case: The account has neither a variation account nor a company default expense account.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped entirely, which is the one exception to the invariant that the ledger equals the physical value after a closing.

edge_cases.case: Part one proposed items on the account.
edge_cases.outcome: Their net debit is subtracted through the extra balance, so the same value is not posted twice.

edge_cases.case: The balance is zero for the company currency.
edge_cases.outcome: No pair is produced.

operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: variation account and closing expense account
operands.source: the inventory valuation account's variation account and closing expense account
operands.constraints: the account is skipped when either is empty

preconditions.condition: The account carries both a variation account and a closing expense account.
preconditions.otherwise: The account is skipped and no pair is produced for it.

preconditions.condition: The computed amount is not zero for the company currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The account is skipped.

procedure: Compute the extra balance per account from the items already proposed by parts one and two.
Let the fiscal year start be the first day of the fiscal year containing today.
Compute the ledger value per account today and as of the fiscal year start.
For each account appearing in either, take its variation and closing expense accounts and skip the account when either is empty.
Compute the balance today as the ledger value today minus the extra balance, and the balance over the period as the balance today minus the balance at the fiscal year start.
Add the existing variation, being the sum of the balances of the posted journal items on the variation account of the company dated not after the report date.
Skip when the result is zero for the company currency.
Produce a balanced pair of journal items debiting the closing expense account and crediting the variation account by that amount, labelled "Closing: Stock Variation Over Period".
records.formula: balance_today = ledger_value_today( account ) − extra_balance( account ) ; balance_year_start = ledger_value_at_fiscal_year_start( account ) ; balance_over_period = balance_today − balance_year_start ; existing_variation = Σ balance of the posted journal items on the variation account , of the company , dated not after the report date ; balance_over_period = balance_over_period + existing_variation

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the period balance is tested against zero and when each journal item is written.

result.name: the period variation journal items
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Proposed as part of the closing entry.

edge_cases.case: The inventory valuation account carries no closing expense account.
edge_cases.outcome: The account is skipped and part three produces nothing for it.

edge_cases.case: The company uses the anglo-saxon convention.
edge_cases.outcome: The movements and the invoices already post the variation, so this part has nothing to add.

edge_cases.case: The result is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The two accounts swap and the amount is replaced by its absolute value.

edge_cases.case: Parts one and two proposed items on the account.
edge_cases.outcome: Their net debit is subtracted through the extra balance, so the period balance is measured against the ledger as it will stand.

edge_cases.case: A variation was already posted in the period.
edge_cases.outcome: The existing variation is added, so the part posts only the amount still missing.

worked_examples.description: An account standing at 400.00 today and at 250.00 at the fiscal year start, with nothing proposed by the earlier parts and no variation yet posted
worked_examples.narrative: Four hundred minus nought is 400.00 today; minus the 250.00 at the fiscal year start gives 150.00 over the period; nothing was already posted on the variation account, so 150.00 is debited to the closing expense account and credited to the variation account.

worked_examples.description: The same account where the inventory valuation account carries no closing expense account
worked_examples.narrative: The closing expense account is empty, so the account is skipped and part three produces nothing.

records.name: The balanced pair rule of the closing
records.purpose: Turns a nominal debit account, a nominal credit account and a balance into two journal items that always balance, swapping the accounts when the balance is negative.

operands.name: nominal debit account
operands.source: the part of the closing producing the pair
operands.constraints: named by the caller

operands.name: nominal credit account
operands.source: the part of the closing producing the pair
operands.constraints: named by the caller

operands.name: balance
operands.source: the part of the closing producing the pair
operands.constraints: may be positive or negative; a zero balance produces no pair

preconditions.condition: The balance is not zero for the company currency.
preconditions.otherwise: No pair is produced.

preconditions.condition: Both accounts are known.
preconditions.otherwise: The pair cannot be produced and the account is skipped.

procedure: Swap the two accounts and replace the balance by its absolute value when the balance is negative.
Produce the first item on the credit account with a debit of zero and a credit equal to the absolute value of the balance.
Produce the second item on the debit account with a debit equal to the absolute value of the balance and a credit of zero.
Give both items the same label, and a product reference when the caller supplied one, which the closing never does.
records.formula: when balance < 0 : swap the two accounts and replace the balance by its absolute value ; item 1 : account = the credit account , debit = 0 , credit = | balance | ; item 2 : account = the debit account , debit = | balance | , credit = 0

rounding.what: The absolute value of the balance.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When each journal item is written.

result.name: the two journal items of the pair
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the closing entry, which is therefore always balanced.

edge_cases.case: The balance is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The two accounts swap, so a fall in the physical value debits the variation account and credits the inventory valuation account.

edge_cases.case: The balance is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: No pair is produced; the caller tests for zero before calling.

edge_cases.case: The caller supplies a product reference.
edge_cases.outcome: Both items carry it; the closing never supplies one.

edge_cases.case: Several pairs are produced.
edge_cases.outcome: Each is balanced on its own, so the whole entry is balanced.

worked_examples.description: A positive balance of 250.00 with inventory valuation as the nominal debit account and the variation account as the nominal credit account
worked_examples.narrative: The balance is positive, so no swap occurs: the variation account is credited 250.00 and the inventory valuation account debited 250.00.

worked_examples.description: A negative balance of minus 50.00 with the same nominal accounts
worked_examples.narrative: The balance is negative, so the accounts swap and the balance becomes 50.00: the inventory valuation account is credited 50.00 and the variation account debited 50.00.

records.name: The last closing instant of a company
records.purpose: Finds the instant the previous closing covered up to, so that a second closing on the same day does not re-include the movements the first one already covered.

operands.name: stored list of closing entry identifiers
operands.source: the company's closing register
operands.constraints: never more than ten identifiers

operands.name: state of each entry
operands.source: the journal entry
operands.constraints: only a posted entry that still exists counts

operands.name: date of the entry
operands.source: the journal entry
operands.constraints: widened to an instant when no tracked change matches

operands.name: creation instant of the latest tracked change of the entry's state field
operands.source: the change tracking of the entry
operands.constraints: used only when its date part equals the entry's date

preconditions.condition: The company's closing register holds at least one identifier of an entry that still exists and is posted.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no last closing instant, so the closing counts every movement from the beginning.

preconditions.condition: A tracked change of the entry's state field exists whose creation date equals the entry's date.
preconditions.otherwise: The entry's date widened to an instant is used instead.

procedure: Read the stored list of closing entry identifiers for the company.
Walk it from the end backwards until an entry is found that still exists and is posted.
Report that there is no last closing instant when none is found.
Otherwise find the latest tracked change of that entry's state field.
When such a change exists and the date part of its creation instant equals the entry's date, take that creation instant, date and time, as the last closing instant.
Otherwise take the entry's date widened to an instant.
records.formula: last_closing_instant = the creation instant of the latest tracked state change of the newest existing posted closing entry, when its date part equals the entry's date ; otherwise the entry's date widened to an instant

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded; the result is an instant.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: the last closing instant
result.unit_or_currency: a date and time
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by part one of the closing as the lower bound of its movement filter, and by the refusal that protects earlier closings.

edge_cases.case: The newest identifier in the register points at an entry that was deleted.
edge_cases.outcome: The walk continues backwards to the next one.

edge_cases.case: The newest entry is not posted.
edge_cases.outcome: The walk continues backwards.

edge_cases.case: No entry in the register still exists and is posted.
edge_cases.outcome: There is no last closing instant and part one counts every movement.

edge_cases.case: Two closings are posted on the same day.
edge_cases.outcome: The creation instant rather than the date is used, so the second one does not re-include the movements the first already covered.

edge_cases.case: The register would exceed ten identifiers.
edge_cases.outcome: The oldest is dropped when a new one is appended.

worked_examples.description: A register whose newest posted entry is dated on the tenth and whose state change was recorded at eleven in the morning of the tenth

inputs.state_change_creation_instant: the tenth at eleven in the morning

expected_outputs.last_closing_instant: the tenth at eleven in the morning

worked_examples.narrative: The date part of the creation instant equals the entry's date, so the instant with its time is used and a second closing on the tenth counts only the movements made after eleven in the morning.

worked_examples.description: The same entry where the state change was recorded on a later day

inputs.state_change_creation_instant: the twelfth at nine in the morning

expected_outputs.last_closing_instant: the tenth, widened to an instant

worked_examples.narrative: The date part of the creation instant does not equal the entry's date, so the entry's date widened to an instant is used.

records.name: The closing operation
records.purpose: Runs the three parts for one company, refuses in five named situations, and writes the closing entry with its register update.

operands.name: company
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: exactly one

operands.name: report date
operands.source: the caller, optionally
operands.constraints: must not be before the last closing date

operands.name: items proposed by the three parts
operands.source: the three parts of the closing
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: inventory journal of the company
operands.source: the company
operands.constraints: must be set

operands.name: inventory valuation account of the company
operands.source: the company
operands.constraints: must be set

operands.name: stored closing register
operands.source: the company
operands.constraints: never more than ten identifiers

preconditions.condition: Exactly one company is in scope.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation cannot run.

preconditions.condition: When a report date is given and a last closing date exists, the report date is not before it.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation is refused with the message "It exists closing entries after the selected date. Cancel them before generate an entry prior to them".

preconditions.condition: The three parts produce at least one journal item.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation returns silently when it was started by the scheduled job, and otherwise is refused with the message "Everything is correctly closed".

preconditions.condition: The company has an inventory journal.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation is refused with the message "Please set the Journal for Inventory Valuation in the settings."

preconditions.condition: The company has an inventory valuation account.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation is refused with the message "Please set the Valuation Account for Inventory Valuation in the settings."

procedure: Check that exactly one company is in scope.
Refuse when a report date is given, a last closing date exists and the report date is before it.
Compute the three parts and, when they produce no journal item at all, return silently for the scheduled job or refuse otherwise.
Refuse when the company has no inventory journal, then when it has no inventory valuation account.
Create a journal entry in the company's inventory journal, dated at the report date or today, referenced "Stock Closing", in the company, carrying every proposed item.
Append its identifier to the company's stored closing list, dropping the oldest when the list would exceed ten.
Post it when the caller asked for automatic posting.
Return a window action opening that entry, titled "Journal Items".
records.formula: number of identifiers kept in the closing register = min( existing count + 1 , 10 ) ; the entry's date = the report date when one is given , otherwise today

rounding.what: Each proposed item's amount, already rounded by its own part.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When each journal item is written by its part.

result.name: the closing journal entry
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Created in the company's inventory journal, referenced "Stock Closing", its identifier appended to the company's closing register.

edge_cases.case: The three parts produce nothing and the scheduled job started the operation.
edge_cases.outcome: The operation returns silently, because other companies may still have work.

edge_cases.case: The three parts produce nothing and a person started the operation.
edge_cases.outcome: The operation is refused with the message "Everything is correctly closed".

edge_cases.case: The closing register already holds ten identifiers.
edge_cases.outcome: The oldest is dropped when the new one is appended.

edge_cases.case: The daily job meets a misconfigured company.
edge_cases.outcome: It skips that company silently, so one misconfigured company does not block the rest.

edge_cases.case: The caller did not ask for automatic posting.
edge_cases.outcome: The entry is created but not posted, so the ledger value does not move until it is.

worked_examples.description: A first closing for a company whose account holds goods worth 250.00 against an empty ledger
worked_examples.narrative: Part two produces the balanced pair for 250.00, the entry is created in the inventory journal with the reference "Stock Closing", its identifier is appended to the register, which now holds one, and the entry is posted.

worked_examples.description: A company whose register already holds ten identifiers
worked_examples.narrative: Appending the new identifier would make eleven, so the oldest is dropped and the register still holds ten.

records.name: Analytic amount of a picked but not yet completed movement
records.purpose: Gives an analytic estimate for goods that have been picked but not yet completed, deliberately using the product's unit cost because the figure is provisional.

operands.name: quantity of the movement
operands.source: the movement, converted into the product reference unit
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: unit cost of the product
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: direction of the movement
operands.source: the movement's classification flags
operands.constraints: an outgoing movement negates the amount

preconditions.condition: The movement's state is neither cancelled nor draft.
preconditions.otherwise: No analytic line is created.

preconditions.condition: The movement is picked.
preconditions.otherwise: No analytic line is created, because a movement that is neither completed nor picked carries none.

procedure: Convert the movement quantity into the product reference unit to obtain the unit amount.
Multiply the unit amount by the product's unit cost to obtain the amount, which is an estimate.
Negate the amount when the movement counts as outgoing.
Delete the existing lines and create nothing when the movement already has analytic lines and both the amount and the unit amount are zero.
records.formula: unit_amount = convert( move_quantity → product_reference_unit ) ; amount = unit_amount × product_unit_cost ; amount = − amount when the movement counts as outgoing

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the currency of the analytic account, or of the company currency when the account has none.
rounding.step: When each analytic line's amount is written; a line whose amount is zero for that currency is deleted instead.

result.name: analytic amount and unit amount of the movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the reference unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: Distributed across the analytic accounts of the movement's distribution and stored on the analytic lines.

edge_cases.case: The movement uses first in first out.
edge_cases.outcome: The estimate still uses the product's unit cost, because re-estimating every analytic line at each outgoing movement would be prohibitively expensive and the figure is provisional.

edge_cases.case: Both the amount and the unit amount are zero and lines already exist.
edge_cases.outcome: The existing lines are deleted and nothing is created.

edge_cases.case: The movement is cancelled or in the draft state.
edge_cases.outcome: No analytic line is created.

edge_cases.case: The movement counts as outgoing.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount is negated.

worked_examples.description: A picked delivery of ten units of a product whose unit cost is 10.00
worked_examples.narrative: Ten multiplied by 10.00 is 100.00, negated because the movement counts as outgoing, so the analytic lines carry minus 100.00 in total.

worked_examples.description: A picked receipt of ten units of the same product
worked_examples.narrative: The same multiplication without the negation gives 100.00.

records.name: Analytic amount of a completed movement
records.purpose: Replaces the estimate by the value the valuation engine actually wrote once the movement is completed, so that analytic reporting agrees with the ledger.

operands.name: value of the movement
operands.source: the movement's value field, as the valuation engine wrote it
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: valued quantity of the movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the movement
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: direction of the movement
operands.source: the movement's classification flags
operands.constraints: an outgoing movement negates the amount

preconditions.condition: The movement's state is completed.
preconditions.otherwise: The estimate applies for a picked movement, and nothing is created otherwise.

preconditions.condition: The movement's state is neither cancelled nor draft.
preconditions.otherwise: No analytic line is created.

procedure: Take the movement's value as the amount and its valued quantity as the unit amount.
Negate the amount when the movement counts as outgoing.
Delete the existing lines and create nothing when the movement already has analytic lines and both the amount and the unit amount are zero.
records.formula: amount = move_value ; unit_amount = move_valued_quantity ; amount = − amount when the movement counts as outgoing

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the currency of the analytic account, or of the company currency when the account has none.
rounding.step: When each analytic line's amount is written; a line whose amount is zero for that currency is deleted instead.

result.name: analytic amount and unit amount of the movement
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the reference unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: Distributed across the analytic accounts of the movement's distribution and stored on the analytic lines.

edge_cases.case: Both the amount and the unit amount are zero and lines already exist.
edge_cases.outcome: The existing lines are deleted and nothing is created.

edge_cases.case: The movement counts as outgoing.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount is negated.

edge_cases.case: The movement is reverted out of the completed state.
edge_cases.outcome: Its stored value is not cleared, but nothing reads it while the classification flags are false.

edge_cases.case: The manufacturing order the movement belongs to is renamed.
edge_cases.outcome: The reference of the analytic lines of its component movements is rewritten, so that analytic reporting keeps pointing at the right document.

worked_examples.description: A completed delivery of ten units valued at 108.00
worked_examples.narrative: The value written by the valuation engine is 108.00, negated because the movement counts as outgoing, so the analytic lines carry minus 108.00 for ten units.

records.name: Distributing an analytic amount across analytic accounts
records.purpose: Turns one amount and one distribution into the set of analytic lines that mirror the object, creating, updating and deleting lines so that the result matches the distribution exactly.

operands.name: distribution
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from one or more analytic accounts to a percentage
operands.source: the object being mirrored
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: amount
operands.source: the analytic amount rule
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: unit amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the analytic amount rule
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: existing analytic lines
operands.source: the object being mirrored
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: additive mode
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: when on, the existing amount and unit amount are added to the new ones

preconditions.condition: The distribution is not empty.
preconditions.otherwise: Every existing line is deleted and nothing is created.

preconditions.condition: Each key of the distribution resolves to a set of analytic accounts.
preconditions.otherwise: The key cannot be applied and no line is created for it.

procedure: Delete every existing line and return nothing when the distribution is empty.
Resolve each key of the distribution into the set of analytic accounts it names.
Compute, per analytic plan, the total percentage assigned to it across the whole distribution.

For each existing line, determine the set of accounts it currently carries; when that set is in the distribution, update the line with the plan's share of the amount and with the unit amount, adding the existing amount and unit amount in additive mode, and remove that set from the distribution so it is not applied twice.

Delete the line instead when the new amount is zero for the account's currency, or for the object's company currency when the account has none, and delete it outright when its set is not in the distribution.
Create a line for each set remaining in the distribution with the computed amount, unless that amount is zero for the currency.
records.formula: new_amount = the plan's share of the amount ; new_unit_amount = unit_amount , or unit_amount + existing_unit_amount in additive mode

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the currency of the analytic account, or of the object's company currency when the account has none.
rounding.step: When each line's amount is computed and compared to zero, before the line is written or deleted.

result.name: the analytic lines mirroring the object
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the reference unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as analytic lines pointing back at the object being mirrored.

edge_cases.case: The distribution is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: Every existing line is deleted and nothing is created.

edge_cases.case: An existing line carries a set of accounts that is not in the distribution.
edge_cases.outcome: It is deleted.

edge_cases.case: The computed amount of a line is zero for its currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is deleted rather than written, and a new line with a zero amount is not created.

edge_cases.case: Additive mode is on.
edge_cases.outcome: The existing amount and unit amount are added to the new ones, so the line accumulates.

edge_cases.case: The same set of accounts appears twice.
edge_cases.outcome: It is removed from the distribution after the first application, so it is not applied twice.

worked_examples.description: An amount of 100.00 distributed over three accounts of one plan at 33.33, 33.33 and 33.34 percent
worked_examples.narrative: The first two lines take their proportional shares of 33.33 each; the third completes the plan's total, so it receives the exact outstanding amount of 33.34 and the three lines sum to exactly 100.00.

records.name: The share of an analytic plan in a distribution
records.purpose: Computes each analytic line's amount so that the amounts distributed inside one plan always add up to the whole amount, by giving the line that completes the plan the exact outstanding amount.

operands.name: amount
operands.source: the analytic amount rule
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: percentage of this line
operands.source: the distribution
operands.constraints: may be any value the distribution carries

operands.name: already-distributed percentage of the plan
operands.source: the running state of the distribution over that plan
operands.constraints: starts at zero

operands.name: total percentage of the plan
operands.source: the sum of the percentages assigned to that plan across the whole distribution
operands.constraints: compared at the analytic-percentage precision

operands.name: already-distributed amount of the plan
operands.source: the running state of the distribution over that plan
operands.constraints: starts at zero

preconditions.condition: The line belongs to an analytic plan whose total percentage is known.
preconditions.otherwise: The proportional branch applies and no closing correction is possible.

preconditions.condition: The comparison of the allocated percentage with the plan's total is made at the analytic-percentage precision.
preconditions.otherwise: A rounding artefact would prevent the closing correction from firing and the amounts would not add up.

procedure: Add this line's percentage to the already-distributed percentage of the plan to obtain the allocated percentage.

When the allocated percentage equals the plan's total percentage, compared at the analytic-percentage precision, set the calculated amount to the amount multiplied by the total percentage divided by one hundred, minus the already-distributed amount.
Otherwise set the calculated amount to the amount multiplied by this line's percentage divided by one hundred.
Add the calculated amount, rounded at the analytic-percentage precision, to the already-distributed amount, and set the already-distributed percentage to the allocated percentage.
records.formula: allocated_percentage = already_distributed_percentage + this_percentage ; when allocated_percentage equals the plan's total percentage ( compared at the analytic-percentage precision ) : calculated_amount = amount × total_percentage ÷ 100 − already_distributed_amount ; otherwise : calculated_amount = amount × this_percentage ÷ 100 ; already_distributed_amount += round( calculated_amount , analytic-percentage precision ) ; already_distributed_percentage = allocated_percentage

rounding.what: The calculated amount as it is accumulated into the already-distributed amount.
rounding.precision: The analytic-percentage precision, which is two decimal places.
rounding.step: When the calculated amount is added to the already-distributed amount, and when the allocated percentage is compared with the plan's total.

result.name: amount of the analytic line
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the analytic line, or used to decide that the line should be deleted when it is zero for the currency.

edge_cases.case: The line completes the plan's total.
edge_cases.outcome: It receives the exact outstanding amount rather than its own proportional share, so the compounding rounding error is absorbed.

edge_cases.case: The plan's total percentage is less than one hundred.
edge_cases.outcome: The closing correction fires at that total, so the distributed amounts add up to the amount multiplied by that total.

edge_cases.case: The percentages do not divide the amount exactly.
edge_cases.outcome: The earlier lines take their proportional shares and the last one takes the difference.

edge_cases.case: The calculated amount is zero for the account's currency.
edge_cases.outcome: No line is created, or an existing line is deleted.

worked_examples.description: One hundred distributed over three accounts of one plan at 33.33, 33.33 and 33.34 percent
worked_examples.narrative: The first line's allocated percentage of 33.33 is not the plan's total, so it takes 100.00 multiplied by 33.33 divided by one hundred, which is 33.33; the second brings the allocated percentage to 66.66 and takes another 33.33; the third brings it to 100.00, which equals the plan's total, so it takes 100.00 multiplied by one hundred divided by one hundred minus the 66.66 already distributed, which is 33.34.

records.name: The value of a stock quantity record
records.purpose: Attributes a share of a product's total value to one stock quantity record, so that a reader can see what the goods at one location are worth.

operands.name: quantity of the stock quantity record
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the stock quantity record
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: reference quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the lot's quantity in the company when the product is valuated by lot, otherwise the product's quantity on hand in the company inside the valued perimeter
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: reference value
operands.source: the lot's total value in the company when the product is valuated by lot, otherwise the product's total value in the company
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: location of the record
operands.source: the stock quantity record
operands.constraints: must be inside the valued perimeter for the value to be non-zero

operands.name: owner of the record
operands.source: the stock quantity record
operands.constraints: must be the company's partner for the value to be non-zero

preconditions.condition: The location of the record is inside the valued perimeter.
preconditions.otherwise: The value is zero.

preconditions.condition: The owner of the record is the company's partner.
preconditions.otherwise: The value is zero, because goods the company does not own are never capitalised.

preconditions.condition: The quantity of the record and the reference quantity are both non-zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The value is zero.

procedure: Take the reference quantity and the reference value from the lot when the product is valuated by lot, and from the product otherwise.
Report zero when the location is outside the valued perimeter, or the owner is somebody other than the company's partner, or the quantity is zero, or the reference quantity is zero.
Otherwise multiply the record's quantity by the reference value and divide by the reference quantity.
records.formula: reference_quantity = lot_quantity_in_company when the product is valuated by lot , otherwise product_quantity_on_hand_in_company_in_the_valued_perimeter ; reference_value = lot_total_value_in_company when the product is valuated by lot , otherwise product_total_value_in_company ; quant_value = 0 when the location is outside the valued perimeter , or the owner is somebody other than the company's partner , or the quantity is zero , or the reference quantity is zero ; quant_value = quant_quantity × reference_value ÷ reference_quantity otherwise

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the value is displayed or written; the proportion itself is not rounded.

result.name: value of the stock quantity record
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the stock quantity record and summed by the forecast report.

edge_cases.case: The location is outside the valued perimeter.
edge_cases.outcome: The value is zero.

edge_cases.case: The owner is a third party, as in a consignment.
edge_cases.outcome: The value is zero and the quantity does not count towards the reference quantity either, because the quantity on hand computation excludes it.

edge_cases.case: The reference quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The value is zero, whatever the reference value.

edge_cases.case: The product is valuated by lot.
edge_cases.outcome: The proportion is taken against the lot's quantity and the lot's total value rather than the product's.

edge_cases.case: The record's quantity is negative.

records.purpose: States what happens to the unit cost when a product moves to standard price, which is nothing: the cost keeps whatever value it had and stops moving.

operands.name: unit cost of the product before the change

operands.source: the product, as the previous method left it
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: new costing method
operands.source: the category the product now belongs to, or the company fallback
operands.constraints: the change is detected before the write

preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is recomputed for that product.

preconditions.condition: The change is detected before the write, by comparing each variant's current costing method against the costing method of the new category or the company fallback.
preconditions.otherwise: The recomputation would not be scheduled for the variants whose method changes.

procedure: Detect, before the write, the variants whose costing method changes.
Schedule a recomputation for them.
Take no action on the unit cost: it keeps whatever value it had at the moment of the change and stops moving.
Recompute the lots of every affected product that is valuated by lot with the new method.

records.name: Costing method change to first in first out
records.purpose: States what happens to the unit cost when a product moves to first in first out, which is the value held divided by the quantity held, or the price of the last receipt.

operands.name: total value of the product
operands.source: the first in first out valuation of the quantity on hand
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: quantity on hand
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the product, in the valued perimeter
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: unit price of the last incoming movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the last incoming movement lookup
operands.constraints: absent or zero in some situations

operands.name: new costing method
operands.source: the category the product now belongs to, or the company fallback
operands.constraints: the change is detected before the write

preconditions.condition: The costing method of the product actually changes.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is recomputed for that product.

preconditions.condition: The quantity on hand is positive, or a last incoming movement exists and yields a non-zero unit price.
preconditions.otherwise: The unit cost is left unchanged.

Otherwise set it to the unit price of the last incoming movement when one exists and yields a non-zero price.
Otherwise leave the unit cost unchanged.
Recompute the lots of every affected product that is valuated by lot with the new method.
records.formula: unit_cost = total_value ÷ quantity_on_hand when the quantity on hand is positive ; unit_cost = the unit price of the last incoming movement when that price is non-zero ; unit_cost unchanged otherwise

rounding.precision: None on storage: full floating precision.

result.name: unit cost of the product

edge_cases.case: The last incoming movement yields a unit price of zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The unit cost is left unchanged.

records.name: Valuation as of a past instant
records.purpose: States the three changes that an as-of instant makes to every batch routine, so that a valuation report for a past date reproduces what the books said then.

operands.name: as-of instant
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: must be a valid instant

operands.name: quantity on hand as of that instant
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the inventory operations domain, by unwinding the movements made since
operands.constraints: may differ from today's quantity

operands.name: unit cost as of that instant
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the valuation history under standard price, or the movement's own value divided by its valued quantity under first in first out
operands.constraints: may be absent, in which case the current cost is used

preconditions.condition: The caller supplied an instant, or a date that is widened to one.
preconditions.otherwise: The routine values as of now.

preconditions.condition: The valuation history of the product still exists.
preconditions.otherwise: A past valuation under standard price falls back to the product's current cost.

procedure: Take the quantity on hand as of that instant, which the inventory operations domain computes by unwinding the movements made since.
Add the condition date not after the instant to every movement filter: in the average replay, in the first in first out stack, in the last-incoming-movement lookup and in the landed cost lookup.
Take the unit cost from the valuation history rather than from the product under standard price.

Take, under first in first out, the movement's own value divided by its valued quantity in the product-cost source of the priority chain instead of today's unit cost, so that re-evaluating a past movement does not drift with the product's current cost.
records.formula: total_value( product , as of the instant ) = the figure the batch routine of the product's costing method produces with the quantity on hand as of that instant and every movement filter restricted to date not after the instant

rounding.what: The total value reported for the past instant.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the total value is displayed.

result.name: unit cost and total value as of the past instant
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit, and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the inventory valuation report for that date and consumed by the closing when a report date is given.

edge_cases.case: The valuation history of the product was deleted.
edge_cases.outcome: A past valuation under standard price falls back to the product's current cost.

edge_cases.case: A landed cost document is dated after the instant.
edge_cases.outcome: It does not contribute to the value of the movement.

edge_cases.case: A manual correction is dated exactly at the instant.
edge_cases.outcome: It is seen, because the lookup uses date not after the as-of instant.

edge_cases.case: A dated unit cost is asked for a product that does not use standard price.
edge_cases.outcome: The system refuses with the message "You can only get the standard price at a given date for products with 'Standard Price' as cost method."

worked_examples.description: A standard-price product created at 10.00 on day one and changed to 20.00 on day four, with receipts of ten units on days one, three and six
worked_examples.narrative: As of day two the cost from the history is 10.00 and ten units are on hand, giving 100.00. As of day five the cost is 20.00 and twenty units are on hand, giving 400.00. Today the cost is 20.00 and thirty units are on hand, giving 600.00.

records.name: Widening a date to the last instant of the day
records.purpose: Turns a plain date supplied by a caller into an instant, so that a valuation as of a day includes everything that happened on that day.

operands.name: date supplied by the caller
operands.source: the report, the closing or the work-in-progress wizard
operands.constraints: must be a valid date

preconditions.condition: The caller supplied a plain date rather than an instant.
preconditions.otherwise: The instant is used as it stands and no widening occurs.

procedure: Take the date supplied by the caller.
Replace it by the last instant of that day.
Use the widened instant in every movement filter, so that everything that happened on that day is included.
records.formula: as_of_instant = the last instant of the day the caller supplied

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded; the result is an instant.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: the widened as-of instant
result.unit_or_currency: a date and time
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by every movement filter of the valuation routines.

edge_cases.case: The caller supplies an instant with a time.
edge_cases.outcome: No widening occurs and the instant is used as it stands.

edge_cases.case: A movement is dated at the very end of the day.
edge_cases.outcome: It is included, which is the point of the widening.

edge_cases.case: A bill line carries a date without a time.
edge_cases.outcome: The as-of instant is reduced to a plain date for the accounting-document source, because bill lines carry a date without a time.

edge_cases.case: The work-in-progress wizard has no date at all.
edge_cases.outcome: The current instant with the time set to the last second of the day is used.

expected_outputs.as_of_instant: the last instant of the fifth
