records.name: The cost of a sales order line with goods movements under a non-standard costing method
records.purpose: Blends the cost of what has actually been delivered with the product's cost for what has not, so that the margin of a partly delivered line reflects the goods that left stock.

operands.name: delivered quantity
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: ordered quantity
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: delivery unit price of the line's completed movements
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the delivery unit price rule
operands.constraints: zero when the delivered quantity is not positive

operands.name: unit cost of the product
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: line unit of measure and line currency
operands.unit_or_currency: a unit of measure and a currency
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: the cost is converted into both

preconditions.condition: The line has at least one goods movement in a state other than cancelled or draft.
preconditions.otherwise: The generic rule applies: the product's unit cost converted into the line's unit of measure and currency.

preconditions.condition: The line's product has a category carrying a costing method other than `standard`.
preconditions.otherwise: The line falls to the later tests: the generic rule when the line has no ordered quantity but does have a delivered quantity, and otherwise the existing cost is left untouched.

procedure: Take the delivered quantity of the line.
Take the delivery unit price of the line's completed movements when the delivered quantity is greater than zero, and zero otherwise.
Set the cost to the product's unit cost when the delivered quantity is not greater than zero.

Otherwise compute the remaining quantity as the ordered quantity minus the delivered quantity, floored at zero, and blend the delivery unit price over the delivered quantity with the product's unit cost over the remaining quantity.
Convert the cost from the product reference unit into the line's unit of measure, then from the product's cost currency into the line's currency.
records.formula: delivered_quantity = qty_delivered ; delivery_unit_price = the delivery unit price of the line's completed movements when delivered_quantity > 0 , else 0 ; when delivered_quantity ≤ 0 : cost = product_unit_cost ; otherwise : remaining_quantity = max( ordered_quantity − delivered_quantity , 0 ) ; cost = ( delivered_quantity × delivery_unit_price + remaining_quantity × product_unit_cost ) ÷ ( delivered_quantity + remaining_quantity )

rounding.precision: The Product Price decimal precision on display; the decimal places of the line currency after the currency conversion.
rounding.step: After the two conversions, when the cost is written on the line.

result.name: cost of the sales order line
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency per line unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the sales order line's cost field and consumed by the margin computation.

edge_cases.case: The delivered quantity is zero or negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The cost is the product's unit cost.

edge_cases.case: The delivered quantity exceeds the ordered quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The remaining quantity is floored at zero, so the cost is the delivery unit price alone.

edge_cases.case: The line has no goods movement outside the cancelled and draft states.
edge_cases.outcome: The generic rule applies.

edge_cases.case: The product uses standard price and the line has an ordered quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The existing cost is left untouched, which is what lets a human override the cost on such a line without the engine overwriting it.

edge_cases.case: The line was created from a delivery under standard price, so it has a delivered quantity and no ordered quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The generic rule applies.

worked_examples.description: A line ordering ten units at a product cost of 11.00, six of which have been delivered for 60.00
worked_examples.narrative: The delivery unit price is 60.00 divided by six, which is 10.00. The remaining quantity is ten minus six, floored at zero, which is four. The cost is six multiplied by 10.00 plus four multiplied by 11.00, which is 60.00 plus 44.00, divided by ten, giving 10.40.

records.name: The generic cost rule of a sales order line
records.purpose: Supplies the cost of a sales order line from the product alone, which is what applies when the line has no goods movement or was created from a delivery under standard price.

operands.name: unit cost of the product
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: line unit of measure
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: must belong to the same category as the product reference unit

operands.name: cost currency of the product and line currency
operands.source: the product's cost currency and the sales order line
operands.constraints: may be the same

preconditions.condition: The line has no goods movement outside the cancelled and draft states, or it has no ordered quantity but does have a delivered quantity.
preconditions.otherwise: The blended rule applies, or the existing cost is left untouched.

preconditions.condition: The line unit of measure and the product reference unit belong to the same category.
preconditions.otherwise: No conversion is possible and the cost cannot be expressed on the line.

procedure: Convert the product's unit cost from the product reference unit into the line's unit of measure.
Convert the result from the product's cost currency into the line's currency.
Write it as the line's cost.
records.formula: cost = convert( convert_price( product_unit_cost , product_reference_unit → line_unit_of_measure ) , product_cost_currency → line_currency )

rounding.precision: The Product Price decimal precision on display; the decimal places of the line currency after the conversion.
rounding.step: After the two conversions, when the cost is written on the line.

result.name: cost of the sales order line
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency per line unit of measure
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the sales order line's cost field and consumed by the margin computation.

edge_cases.case: The line unit of measure is the product reference unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The first conversion leaves the cost unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The line currency is the product's cost currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The second conversion leaves the cost unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The product's unit cost is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The line's cost is zero and the margin is the whole subtotal.

edge_cases.case: The product uses standard price and the line has both an ordered quantity and a movement.
edge_cases.outcome: This rule does not run; the existing cost is left untouched so that a human override survives.

worked_examples.description: A product whose unit cost is 11.00 sold in the reference unit in the company currency
worked_examples.narrative: Neither conversion changes anything, so the line's cost is 11.00.

worked_examples.description: The same product sold by the dozen
worked_examples.narrative: The price conversion multiplies the unit cost by the dozen factor of twelve, giving 132.00 per dozen.

records.name: The delivery unit price of a set of movements
records.purpose: Combines the drop-shipment part and the ordinary outgoing part of a set of movements into one price per unit, which is the figure the cost of a sales order line is blended from.

operands.name: valued quantity and value of each drop-shipment movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure and the company currency
operands.source: the movements of the set that are drop shipments or returned drop shipments
operands.constraints: the value is re-evaluated through the priority chain

operands.name: valued quantity and value of each ordinary outgoing movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure and the company currency
operands.source: the remaining movements of the set whose outgoing flag is set
operands.constraints: the value is read from the stored field

operands.name: plain unit price of the whole set
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit
operands.source: the plain unit price rule
operands.constraints: used when the total quantity is zero

preconditions.condition: The set contains movements of one product only.
preconditions.otherwise: The plain unit price of the whole set is zero, so the fallback is zero as well.

preconditions.condition: The total quantity is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The plain unit price of the whole set is used instead of the blend.

procedure: Split the set into the drop-shipment movements, being the drop shipments and returned drop shipments, and the remaining movements whose outgoing flag is set.
Sum the valued quantities of the drop-shipment movements and divide the sum of their values by that quantity, taking zero when it is zero.
Sum the valued quantities of the ordinary outgoing movements and divide the sum of their values by that quantity, taking zero when it is zero.
Add the two quantities to obtain the total quantity.
Return the plain unit price of the whole set when the total quantity is zero.
Otherwise blend the two prices weighted by their quantities and divide by the total quantity.
records.formula: dropship_quantity = Σ valued quantity over the drop-shipment movements ; dropship_price = Σ value over those movements ÷ dropship_quantity ( 0 when dropship_quantity is 0 ) ; regular_quantity = Σ valued quantity over the remaining outgoing movements ; regular_price = Σ value over those movements ÷ regular_quantity ( 0 when that sum is 0 ) ; total_quantity = dropship_quantity + regular_quantity ; delivery_unit_price = the plain unit price of the whole set when total_quantity is 0 ; delivery_unit_price = ( dropship_quantity × dropship_price + regular_quantity × regular_price ) ÷ total_quantity otherwise

rounding.precision: The Product Price decimal precision on display.
rounding.step: When the cost of the line is written; the blend itself is not rounded.

result.name: delivery unit price of the set
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the cost of a sales order line.

edge_cases.case: The set contains no drop shipment.
edge_cases.outcome: The drop-shipment quantity and price are zero and the blend reduces to the ordinary outgoing price.

edge_cases.case: The set contains only drop shipments.
edge_cases.outcome: The blend reduces to the drop-shipment price.

edge_cases.case: The total quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The plain unit price of the whole set is used.

edge_cases.case: The set covers more than one product.
edge_cases.outcome: The plain unit price is zero, so the fallback is zero.

edge_cases.case: A drop-shipment movement's stored value is stale.
edge_cases.outcome: It does not matter: the drop-shipment price re-evaluates each movement through the priority chain rather than reading the stored field.

worked_examples.description: Two ordinary deliveries of six units worth 60.00 and four units worth 48.00, with no drop shipment
worked_examples.narrative: The drop-shipment part is empty, so the blend is ten multiplied by 10.80 divided by ten, which is 10.80.

worked_examples.description: A drop shipment of four units worth 52.00 alongside an ordinary delivery of six units worth 60.00
worked_examples.narrative: The drop-shipment price is 52.00 divided by four, which is 13.00, and the ordinary price is 60.00 divided by six, which is 10.00; the blend is four multiplied by 13.00 plus six multiplied by 10.00, which is 112.00, divided by ten, giving 11.20.

records.name: The plain unit price of a set of movements
records.purpose: Divides the stored values of a set of movements by their stored valued quantities, which is the fallback the delivery unit price uses when there is no quantity to weight by.

operands.name: value of each movement
operands.source: the movements of the set, read from the stored field
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: valued quantity of each movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the movements of the set
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: number of distinct products in the set
operands.source: the movements of the set
operands.constraints: must be one for a non-zero result

preconditions.condition: The total valued quantity of the set is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is zero.

preconditions.condition: The set covers exactly one product.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is zero.

procedure: Sum the values of the movements of the set.
Sum their valued quantities.
Report zero when the total valued quantity is zero or when the set covers more than one product.
Otherwise divide the total value by the total valued quantity.
records.formula: plain_unit_price = Σ move value ÷ Σ move valued quantity ; plain_unit_price = 0 when the total valued quantity is 0 ; plain_unit_price = 0 when the set covers more than one product

rounding.precision: The Product Price decimal precision on display.
rounding.step: At display, and when the cost of the line it feeds is written.

result.name: plain unit price of the set
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the delivery unit price as its fallback.

edge_cases.case: The total valued quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The price is zero.

edge_cases.case: The set covers more than one product.
edge_cases.outcome: The price is zero.

edge_cases.case: The set is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The sums are zero and the price is zero.

edge_cases.case: The total value is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The price is negative.

worked_examples.description: Two deliveries of six units worth 60.00 and four units worth 48.00 of the same product
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred and eight divided by ten is 10.80.

worked_examples.description: A set covering two different products
worked_examples.narrative: The set covers more than one product, so the price is zero.

records.name: The drop-shipment unit price of a set of movements
records.purpose: Divides the re-evaluated values of a set of movements by their valued quantities, so that a drop shipment is priced from what the priority chain says now rather than from a stored field.

operands.name: value produced by the priority chain for each movement
operands.source: the priority chain, re-evaluated rather than read from the stored field
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: valued quantity of each movement
operands.unit_or_currency: the reference unit of measure of the product
operands.source: the movements of the set
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The total valued quantity is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is zero.

preconditions.condition: The movements are drop shipments or returned drop shipments.
preconditions.otherwise: The plain unit price applies instead, reading the stored values.

procedure: Re-evaluate each movement of the set through the priority chain rather than reading its stored value.
Sum the evaluated values and sum the valued quantities.
Divide the total evaluated value by the total valued quantity, reporting zero when that quantity is zero.
records.formula: dropship_unit_price = Σ evaluated value ÷ Σ valued quantity ( 0 when the total valued quantity is 0 )

rounding.precision: The Product Price decimal precision on display.
rounding.step: At display, and when the cost of the line it feeds is written.

result.name: drop-shipment unit price of the set
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency per reference unit of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the delivery unit price of the set.

edge_cases.case: The total valued quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The price is zero.

edge_cases.case: A movement's stored value differs from what the chain produces now.
edge_cases.outcome: The re-evaluated value is used, which is the point of this rule.

edge_cases.case: A drop shipment is billed after the fact.
edge_cases.outcome: The chain's accounting-document source picks the bill up, so the price rises or falls accordingly.

edge_cases.case: A drop shipment never produces a valuation entry.
edge_cases.outcome: That is correct: the valuation-entry test requires the incoming or outgoing flag, which a drop shipment does not carry.

worked_examples.description: A drop shipment of four units re-evaluated at 52.00
worked_examples.narrative: Fifty-two divided by four is 13.00.

worked_examples.description: A drop shipment whose valued quantity is zero
worked_examples.narrative: The total valued quantity is zero, so the price is zero.

records.name: The margin of a sales order line that is delivered but not ordered
records.purpose: Computes the margin of a line created from a delivery, where there is a delivered quantity but no ordered quantity, so the subtotal must be recomputed from the delivered quantity.

operands.name: unit price of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency per line unit of measure
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: delivered quantity
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: not zero in this branch

operands.name: ordered quantity
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: zero in this branch

operands.name: cost of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency per line unit of measure
operands.source: the cost rules of the line
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The delivered quantity is not zero and the ordered quantity is zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The ordinary margin rule applies, based on the line subtotal and the ordered quantity.

preconditions.condition: The calculated subtotal is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The margin percentage is zero.

procedure: Multiply the unit price by the delivered quantity to obtain the calculated subtotal.
Subtract the cost multiplied by the delivered quantity from the calculated subtotal to obtain the margin.
Divide the margin by the calculated subtotal to obtain the margin percentage, reporting zero when the calculated subtotal is zero.
records.formula: calculated_subtotal = unit_price × delivered_quantity ; margin = calculated_subtotal − cost × delivered_quantity ; margin_percentage = margin ÷ calculated_subtotal ( 0 when the calculated subtotal is 0 )

rounding.what: The margin and the margin percentage.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the line currency for the margin; the margin percentage is a ratio.
rounding.step: When the margin is displayed or stored.

result.name: margin and margin percentage of the line
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and a ratio
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the sales order line.

edge_cases.case: The calculated subtotal is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The margin percentage is zero, whatever the margin.

edge_cases.case: The cost exceeds the unit price.
edge_cases.outcome: The margin is negative and so is the percentage.

edge_cases.case: The ordered quantity is not zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The ordinary margin rule applies instead.

edge_cases.case: The cost is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The margin equals the calculated subtotal and the percentage is one.

worked_examples.description: A line delivered in a quantity of six at a unit price of 20.00 with a cost of 10.00
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty multiplied by six is a calculated subtotal of 120.00; minus 10.00 multiplied by six, which is 60.00, gives a margin of 60.00 and a percentage of 60.00 divided by 120.00, which is 0.5.

records.name: The margin of an ordinary sales order line
records.purpose: Computes the margin of a line that carries an ordered quantity, as the subtotal less the cost of the ordered quantity.

operands.name: subtotal of the line
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: cost of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency per line unit of measure
operands.source: the cost rules of the line
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: ordered quantity
operands.source: the sales order line
operands.constraints: may be zero

preconditions.condition: The line has an ordered quantity, or it has no delivered quantity.
preconditions.otherwise: The delivered-but-not-ordered branch applies.

preconditions.condition: The subtotal is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The margin percentage is zero.

procedure: Multiply the cost by the ordered quantity.
Subtract the product from the line subtotal to obtain the margin.
Divide the margin by the line subtotal to obtain the margin percentage, reporting zero when the subtotal is zero.
records.formula: margin = line_subtotal − cost × ordered_quantity ; margin_percentage = margin ÷ line_subtotal ( 0 when the subtotal is 0 )

rounding.what: The margin and the margin percentage.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the line currency for the margin; the margin percentage is a ratio.
rounding.step: When the margin is displayed or stored.

result.name: margin and margin percentage of the line
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and a ratio
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the sales order line.

edge_cases.case: The subtotal is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The margin percentage is zero.

edge_cases.case: The cost exceeds the unit price.
edge_cases.outcome: The margin is negative.

edge_cases.case: The line carries a discount.
edge_cases.outcome: The subtotal already reflects it, so the margin falls accordingly.

edge_cases.case: Only part of the line is delivered.
edge_cases.outcome: The cost is the blend of the delivery unit price over the delivered quantity and the product's unit cost over the remainder.

worked_examples.description: A line ordering ten units at 20.00 each with a blended cost of 10.40
worked_examples.narrative: Ten multiplied by 10.40 is 104.00; 200.00 minus 104.00 is a margin of 96.00, and 96.00 divided by 200.00 is a percentage of 0.48.

records.name: The value shown on the forecast report
records.purpose: Sums the values of the stock quantity records a forecast report covers, so that an inventory manager sees what the goods in the warehouse locations of the report are worth.

operands.name: value of each stock quantity record
operands.source: the stock quantity record value rule
operands.constraints: zero for a record outside the valued perimeter or owned by a third party

operands.name: set of warehouse locations
operands.source: the report
operands.constraints: at least one

operands.name: company of the first of those locations
operands.source: the first location of the set
operands.constraints: determines which records are summed

operands.name: currency decimal places, symbol and position
operands.unit_or_currency: a count of decimal places, a symbol and a position setting
operands.source: the company currency
operands.constraints: govern the formatting only

preconditions.condition: The reader is an inventory manager.
preconditions.otherwise: The value is not shown at all.

preconditions.condition: At least one location is given.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no company to scope the sum to and no value is shown.

procedure: Take the company of the first of the given locations.
Collect the stock quantity records of the product in that company that sit in one of those locations.
Sum their values.
Format the result with the decimal places and the symbol of the company currency, placing the symbol before or after the number according to the currency's position setting.
records.formula: report_value = Σ value over the stock quantity records of the product in the company of the first of those locations that sit in one of those locations

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.step: When the figure is formatted for display.

result.name: value shown on the forecast report
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the forecast report, formatted with the company currency's decimal places, symbol and symbol position.

edge_cases.case: The reader is not an inventory manager.
edge_cases.outcome: The value is not shown.

edge_cases.case: A record sits outside the valued perimeter.
edge_cases.outcome: Its own value is zero, so it contributes nothing.

edge_cases.case: A record is owned by a third party.
edge_cases.outcome: Its value is zero and it contributes nothing.

edge_cases.case: The locations belong to different companies.
edge_cases.outcome: The company of the first location governs the sum.

worked_examples.description: Two records of the same product in the warehouse locations of the report, holding forty units worth 500.00 and sixty units worth 750.00
worked_examples.narrative: Five hundred plus seven hundred and fifty is 1 250.00, formatted with the two decimal places and the symbol of the company currency.

worked_examples.description: The same report where one record is held for a third-party owner
worked_examples.narrative: The third-party record is valued at zero, so the report still shows 1 250.00.
